+"""Check FSDP2 CPU offloading on CUDA and NPU, without external model weights.
+
+Launch from the repository root on two or more accelerators:
+    PYTHONPATH=. torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=2 \
+        tests/special_distributed/test_fsdp2_model_cpu_offload.py
+
+The uneven vectors require CPU repadding even with two ranks. With 32 ranks,
+their length is 4304, reproducing the 135-element shards and 119-element tail
+from the Qwen3-Omni vision bias failure. Evenly sharded vectors are controls.
+"""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch.distributed import init_device_mesh
+
+from verl.utils.device import get_device_id, get_device_name, get_torch_device
+from verl.utils.distributed import initialize_global_process_group
+from verl.utils.fsdp_utils import (
+    CPUOffloadPolicy,
+    fsdp2_load_full_state_dict,
+    fully_shard,
+    load_fsdp_model_to_gpu,
+    offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu,
+)
+
+
+def _build_model(mesh):
+    world_size = mesh.size()
+    lengths = {"uneven": world_size * 135 - world_size // 2, "even": world_size * 135}
+    model = torch.nn.Sequential()
+    expected = {}
+    # Put large shards first so small preceding transfers cannot drain the queued
+    # work before the uneven D2H copy. On two ranks these have 4+3 and 4+4 rows.
+    for index, rows in enumerate((world_size * 4 - 1, world_size * 4)):
+        layer = torch.nn.Linear(262144, rows, bias=False, device=get_device_id())
+        value = torch.full((rows, 262144), (index + 1) / 8, dtype=layer.weight.dtype)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            layer.weight.copy_(value)
+        expected[f"{len(model)}.weight"] = value
+        fully_shard(layer, mesh=mesh)
+        model.append(layer)
+    for index in range(27):
+        layer = torch.nn.Module()
+        for name, length in lengths.items():
+            # Exactly representable BF16 values, distinct across layers and positions.
+            value = ((torch.arange(length) + index) % 127 + 1).to(torch.bfloat16) / 128
+            expected[f"{len(model)}.{name}"] = value
+            layer.register_parameter(name, torch.nn.Parameter(value.to(get_device_id())))
+        fully_shard(layer, mesh=mesh)
+        model.append(layer)
+    fully_shard(model, mesh=mesh)
+    return model, expected
+
+
+def _check_parameters(model, expected, phase, *, full=False):
+    rank, world_size = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+    failures = []
+    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+        if full:
+            # Every rank must finish the collectives, even if an earlier parameter differs.
+            actual = param.full_tensor().cpu()
+            reference = expected[name]
+        else:
+            actual = param.to_local()
+            reference = expected[name].chunk(world_size)[rank]
+            assert actual.device.type == "cpu", f"{phase}: {name} was not offloaded"
+        try:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, reference, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        except AssertionError as error:
+            failures.append(f"{name}: {error}")
+
+    # Report each rank separately, after every local comparison and collective
+    # needed to reconstruct parameters has finished.
+    failed_rank = torch.tensor([int(bool(failures))], device=get_device_id())
+    failed_ranks = [torch.empty_like(failed_rank) for _ in range(world_size)]
+    dist.all_gather(failed_ranks, failed_rank)
+    counts = [item.item() for item in failed_ranks]
+    assert not any(counts), f"{phase}, failed ranks={counts}, rank {rank}: " + "\n".join(failures)
+
+
+def _queue_work(matrices):
+    # Reuse warmed-up buffers on the actual conversion stream. No host sleep,
+    # tensor reads, synchronization, or collectives before the offload call.
+    left, right, out = matrices
+    for _ in range(64):
+        torch.mm(left, right, out=out)
+
+
+def _update_parameters(model, expected):
+    # Change values between trials so a reused allocation containing an earlier
+    # result cannot hide an incomplete copy. References own independent storage.
+    rank, world_size = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
+        expected[name].add_(1 / 128)
+        param.to_local().copy_(expected[name].chunk(world_size)[rank])
+    get_torch_device().synchronize()
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def main():
+    device_name = get_device_name()
+    assert device_name in ("cuda", "npu"), "this regression requires CUDA or NPU"
+    _, rank, world_size = initialize_global_process_group()
+    try:
+        assert world_size >= 2, "launch with at least two ranks to exercise uneven shards"
+        mesh = init_device_mesh(device_name, (world_size,))
+        model, expected = _build_model(mesh)
+        _check_parameters(model, expected, "initial sharding", full=True)
+
+        # Cover the initialization path as well as explicit runtime offloading.
+        full_state = {name: value.clone() for name, value in expected.items()} if rank == 0 else {}
+        fsdp2_load_full_state_dict(model, full_state, device_mesh=mesh, cpu_offload=CPUOffloadPolicy())
+        _check_parameters(model, expected, "initial load/offload")
+        load_fsdp_model_to_gpu(model)
+        _check_parameters(model, expected, "initial full export", full=True)
+
+        accelerator = get_torch_device()
+        matrices = tuple(torch.ones((2048, 2048), device=get_device_id(), dtype=torch.float16) for _ in range(3))
+        _queue_work(matrices)
+        accelerator.synchronize()
+        for stream_index, stream in enumerate((accelerator.current_stream(), accelerator.Stream())):
+            # Setup and previous round trips are complete before changing streams.
+            with accelerator.stream(stream):
+                for iteration in range(5):
+                    phase = f"stream {stream_index}, iteration {iteration}"
+                    _update_parameters(model, expected)
+                    _queue_work(matrices)
+                    offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu(model, empty_cache=False)
+                    accelerator.synchronize()
+                    # Check after synchronization: failures here are persistent
+                    # corruption, not just observing an unfinished DMA transfer.
+                    _check_parameters(model, expected, f"CPU shards, {phase}")
+                    load_fsdp_model_to_gpu(model)
+                    _check_parameters(model, expected, f"full export, {phase}", full=True)
+
+                    # Production round trip without intervening host reads or synchronization.
+                    _update_parameters(model, expected)
+                    _queue_work(matrices)
+                    offload_fsdp_model_to_cpu(model, empty_cache=False)
+                    load_fsdp_model_to_gpu(model)
+                    accelerator.synchronize()
+                    _check_parameters(model, expected, f"unobserved round trip, {phase}", full=True)
+            accelerator.synchronize()
+
+        if rank == 0:
+            print(f"FSDP2 {device_name} CPU offload passed: {world_size} ranks, default and non-default streams")
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Dense gradient oracles for automatic score-centering alignment and its tail proxy."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from verl.trainer.ppo.score_centering import (
+    score_centering_auto_correction,
+    score_centering_correction,
+    score_centering_weight_fn,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rule,threshold", [(None, 2.0), ("token", 2.0), ("token", "0.5_5.0")])
+def test_mixed_alignment_matches_dense_score_gradient(rule, threshold):
+    # Row 0 has complete recorded support. Row 1 records only part of the sampler.
+    # Both rows are off-policy so this checks clipping and the normalizer, not a zero gradient.
+    initial = torch.tensor([[1.0, 0.2, -0.3, 0.7, -0.4], [0.3, -0.2, 0.8, -0.7, 0.1]])
+    ids = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 2]])
+    q_head = torch.tensor([[0.65, 0.35, 0.0], [0.10, 0.20, 0.35]])
+    complete = torch.tensor([True, False])
+    weight = score_centering_weight_fn(rule, threshold)
+    logits = initial.clone().requires_grad_()
+    lp = logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    correction, shift, q_mass, p_mass = score_centering_auto_correction(
+        lp.gather(-1, ids), q_head.log(), weight, complete
+    )
+    actual_grad = torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), logits)[0]
+
+    oracle_logits = initial.clone().requires_grad_()
+    oracle_lp = oracle_logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    # Explicit dense sampler proxy. The complete row uses the actual support;
+    # the incomplete row retains head q and distributes residual mass over the trainer tail.
+    support_lp = oracle_logits[0, :2].log_softmax(-1)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        aligned_weights = weight((support_lp - q_head[0, :2].log()).exp())
+        p = oracle_lp[1].exp()
+        q_proxy = torch.cat([q_head[1], (1 - q_head[1].sum()) * p[3:] / p[3:].sum()])
+        proxy_weights = weight((oracle_lp[1] - q_proxy.log()).exp())
+    oracle = (q_head[0, :2] * aligned_weights * support_lp).sum()
+    oracle += (q_proxy * proxy_weights * oracle_lp[1]).sum()
+    oracle_grad = torch.autograd.grad(oracle, oracle_logits)[0]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual_grad, oracle_grad, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(shift[0], lp[0, :2].logsumexp(-1))
+    assert shift[1] == 0
+    torch.testing.assert_close(q_mass, q_head.sum(-1))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(p_mass, torch.stack([lp[0, :2].exp().sum(), lp[1, :3].exp().sum()]))
+
+
+def test_unit_head_mass_without_receipt_does_not_align():
+    logits = torch.tensor([[2.0, 0.8, 0.2, -1.0]], requires_grad=True)
+    head = logits.log_softmax(-1)[:, :2]
+    q = torch.tensor([[0.7, 0.3]]).log()
+    weight = score_centering_weight_fn(None, 2.0)
+    correction, shift, _, _ = score_centering_auto_correction(head, q, weight, torch.tensor([False]))
+    reference, _, _ = score_centering_correction(head, q, weight)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(correction, reference)
+    assert shift.item() == 0
+    assert torch.isfinite(torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), logits)[0]).all()
+
+
+def test_equal_configured_k_with_cutoff_ties_uses_partial_tail_proxy():
+    logits = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0]], requires_grad=True)
+    # Sampling top-k=2 retains the tied third token; the recording budget is still two.
+    q = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 1.0, -torch.inf]]).log_softmax(-1)
+    head = logits.log_softmax(-1)[:, :2]
+    correction, shift, q_mass, _ = score_centering_auto_correction(
+        head, q[:, :2], score_centering_weight_fn("token", 2.0), torch.tensor([False])
+    )
+    assert q_mass.item() == pytest.approx(0.7880584)
+    assert shift.item() == 0
+    assert torch.isfinite(torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), logits)[0]).all()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rule,threshold", [(None, 2.0), ("token", 2.0), ("token", "0.5_5.0")])
+def test_sampled_token_outside_head_keeps_actual_probability(rule, threshold):
+    logits = torch.tensor([[1.2, 0.4, -0.1, 0.3]], requires_grad=True)
+    lp = logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    q_head = torch.tensor([[0.45, 0.25]])
+    q_sample = torch.tensor([0.20])
+    weight = score_centering_weight_fn(rule, threshold)
+    correction, shift, _, _ = score_centering_auto_correction(lp[:, :2], q_head.log(), weight, torch.tensor([False]))
+    sampled = lp[:, 2] - shift
+    actual_sampled_weight = weight((sampled.detach() - q_sample.log()).exp())
+    loss = -(actual_sampled_weight * sampled - correction).mean()
+    assert shift.item() == 0
+    assert torch.equal(q_sample, torch.tensor([0.20]))
+    assert torch.isfinite(torch.autograd.grad(loss, logits)[0]).all()

+"""Token-weighted SC diagnostics across uneven microbatches and data-parallel ranks."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from tensordict import TensorDict
+
+from verl.trainer.config.algorithm import RolloutCorrectionConfig
+from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
+from verl.utils.metric import AggregationType, Metric
+from verl.workers.config import ActorConfig, PolicyLossConfig
+from verl.workers.utils.losses import ppo_loss
+from verl.workers.utils.padding import left_right_2_no_padding
+
+
+def _microbatch_metrics(response_length, aligned, dp_size, global_tokens, global_batch_size):
+    prompt_length = 2
+    sequence_length = prompt_length + response_length
+    data = TensorDict(
+        {
+            "prompts": torch.zeros(1, prompt_length, dtype=torch.long),
+            "responses": torch.zeros(1, response_length, dtype=torch.long),
+            "input_ids": torch.zeros(1, sequence_length, dtype=torch.long),
+            "attention_mask": torch.ones(1, sequence_length, dtype=torch.long),
+            "position_ids": torch.arange(sequence_length).unsqueeze(0),
+            "response_mask": torch.ones(1, response_length, dtype=torch.long),
+            "old_log_probs": torch.zeros(1, response_length),
+            "advantages": torch.zeros(1, response_length),
+        },
+        batch_size=[1],
+    )
+    tu.assign_non_tensor(data, dp_size=dp_size, batch_num_tokens=global_tokens, global_batch_size=global_batch_size)
+    data = left_right_2_no_padding(data)
+
+    def packed_response_metric(value):
+        # Non-response prediction rows have deliberately invalid diagnostic values;
+        # ppo_loss must exclude them before aggregating the global response-token fraction.
+        row = torch.full((sequence_length,), 999.0)
+        row[prompt_length - 1 : prompt_length - 1 + response_length] = value
+        return torch.nested.as_nested_tensor([row], layout=torch.jagged)
+
+    zero = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor([torch.zeros(sequence_length)], layout=torch.jagged)
+    model_output = {
+        "log_probs": zero,
+        "sc_correction": zero,
+        "sc_support_aligned": packed_response_metric(float(aligned)),
+        "sc_support_unknown": packed_response_metric(float(not aligned)),
+        "sc_sampler_tail_mass": packed_response_metric(0.0 if aligned else 0.25),
+    }
+    config = ActorConfig(
+        strategy="fsdp",
+        rollout_n=1,
+        ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1,
+        policy_loss=PolicyLossConfig(
+            loss_mode="bypass_mode", rollout_correction=RolloutCorrectionConfig.bypass_pg_sc()
+        ),
+        loss_agg_mode="token-mean",
+    )
+    _, metrics = ppo_loss(config, model_output, data)
+    return metrics
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "rank_microbatches",
+    [
+        (((1, True), (100, False)),),
+        (((1, True),), ((100, False),)),
+        (((1, True), (49, False)), ((1, False), (50, False))),
+    ],
+    ids=["uneven-microbatches", "uneven-dp-ranks", "uneven-microbatches-and-dp"],
+)
+def test_score_centering_diagnostics_use_the_global_response_token_denominator(rank_microbatches):
+    global_tokens = sum(length for rank in rank_microbatches for length, _ in rank)
+    global_batch_size = sum(len(rank) for rank in rank_microbatches)
+    dp_size = len(rank_microbatches)
+    per_rank = []
+    for microbatches in rank_microbatches:
+        rank_metrics = {}
+        for length, aligned in microbatches:
+            metrics = _microbatch_metrics(length, aligned, dp_size, global_tokens, global_batch_size)
+            for key in ("actor/sc_support_aligned", "actor/sc_support_unknown", "actor/sc_sampler_tail_mass"):
+                assert metrics[key].aggregation is AggregationType.SUM
+                rank_metrics.setdefault(key, metrics[key].init_list()).extend(metrics[key])
+        per_rank.append(rank_metrics)
+    # This is the same rank reduction used by TrainingWorker.train_mini_batch.
+    combined = {key: Metric.aggregate_dp([rank[key] for rank in per_rank]) for key in per_rank[0]}
+    assert combined["actor/sc_support_aligned"] == pytest.approx(1 / 101)
+    assert combined["actor/sc_support_unknown"] == pytest.approx(100 / 101)
+    assert combined["actor/sc_sampler_tail_mass"] == pytest.approx(25 / 101)

+"""Finite-gradient acceptance for the inherited near-zero-tail regularization.
+
+The epsilon floor is an additional numerical approximation. The dense-oracle error is
+reported as a diagnostic, rather than treating exact gradient parity as this test's gate.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from verl.trainer.ppo.score_centering import score_centering_auto_correction, score_centering_weight_fn
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("logit_gap", [16.118095, 35.0])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rule,threshold", [(None, 2.0), ("token", 2.0), ("token", "0.5_5.0")])
+def test_near_zero_trainer_tail_has_finite_correction_and_sampled_loss_gradients(
+    logit_gap, rule, threshold, record_property
+):
+    # Only token 0 is recorded. The actual sampled token 1 remains outside the head;
+    # the declared head-tail model assigns it the remaining sampler mass of 0.5.
+    logits = torch.tensor([[0.0, -logit_gap]], requires_grad=True)
+    log_p = logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    q = torch.tensor([[0.5, 0.5]])
+    weight = score_centering_weight_fn(rule, threshold)
+    correction, shift, sampler_mass, trainer_mass = score_centering_auto_correction(
+        log_p[:, :1], q[:, :1].log(), weight, torch.tensor([False])
+    )
+    correction_grad = torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), logits, retain_graph=True)[0]
+    sampled_weight = weight((log_p[:, 1].detach() - q[:, 1].log()).exp())
+    loss = (correction - sampled_weight * (log_p[:, 1] - shift)).mean()
+    loss_grad = torch.autograd.grad(loss, logits)[0]
+    for value in (correction, shift, sampler_mass, trainer_mass, correction_grad, loss, loss_grad):
+        assert torch.isfinite(value).all()
+    assert shift.item() == 0.0
+
+    oracle_logits = torch.tensor([[0.0, -logit_gap]], requires_grad=True)
+    oracle_log_p = oracle_logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    oracle_weights = weight((oracle_log_p.detach() - q.log()).exp())
+    oracle = (q * oracle_weights * oracle_log_p).sum()
+    oracle_grad = torch.autograd.grad(oracle, oracle_logits)[0]
+    error = (correction_grad - oracle_grad).abs().max().item()
+    record_property("exact_tail_oracle_max_abs_gradient_error", error)

+def _full_vocab_centering(logits, sampler_log_probs):
+    # Exact centering term over the whole vocabulary: sum_v sg[q_v] log p_v.
+    log_p = torch.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
+    return (sampler_log_probs.exp().detach() * log_p).sum(-1)
+

+def test_topk_log_probs_match_log_softmax_gather_with_gradient():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)

+    ids = torch.stack([torch.randperm(37)[:4] for _ in range(5)])
+    out = topk_log_probs_from_logits(logits, ids, chunk_size=2)

+    logits.grad = None
+    (ref * weight).sum().backward()

+def test_topk_correction_gradient_equals_full_vocab_when_k_is_vocab():
+    # With k = V the head/tail split is degenerate (rho = 0/0), so only the gradient of the
+    # correction is meaningful; it must match the exact full-vocab centering term's gradient.
+    torch.manual_seed(2)
+    vocab = 9
+    trainer_logits = torch.randn(4, vocab, requires_grad=True)
+    sampler_log_probs = torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(4, vocab), dim=-1)
+    ids = torch.arange(vocab).expand(4, vocab)
+    head = topk_log_probs_from_logits(trainer_logits, ids)
+    correction, _, _ = score_centering_correction(head, sampler_log_probs, score_centering_weight_fn(None, 2.0))
+    ref = _full_vocab_centering(trainer_logits, sampler_log_probs)
+    grad_a = torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), trainer_logits)[0]
+    grad_b = torch.autograd.grad(ref.sum(), trainer_logits)[0]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad_a, grad_b, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)

+def test_topk_correction_gradient_matches_tail_model():
+    # With k < V the tail is modeled as rho * p; the expected gradient must equal
+    # the exact gradient of sum_v sg[q_hat_v] log p_v with q_hat from the paper.
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    vocab, k = 13, 5
+    trainer_logits = torch.randn(2, vocab, requires_grad=True)
+    sampler_log_probs = torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(2, vocab), dim=-1)
+    ids = torch.topk(sampler_log_probs, k=k, dim=-1).indices
+    head = topk_log_probs_from_logits(trainer_logits, ids)
+    correction, q_mass, p_mass = score_centering_correction(
+        head, sampler_log_probs.gather(-1, ids), score_centering_weight_fn(None, 2.0)
+    )
+    log_p = torch.log_softmax(trainer_logits, dim=-1)
+    p = log_p.exp().detach()
+    q_hat = sampler_log_probs.exp().clone()
+    in_head = torch.zeros_like(q_hat, dtype=torch.bool).scatter_(1, ids, True)
+    rho = (1 - q_mass) / (1 - p_mass)
+    q_hat = torch.where(in_head, q_hat, rho.unsqueeze(-1) * p)
+    ref = (q_hat.detach() * log_p).sum(-1)
+    grad_a = torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), trainer_logits)[0]
+    grad_b = torch.autograd.grad(ref.sum(), trainer_logits)[0]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad_a, grad_b, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+

+def test_composed_correction_uses_alpha_rho_f_one_over_rho():
+    torch.manual_seed(5)
+    head_p = torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(2, 6), dim=-1)[:, :3]
+    head_q = torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(2, 6), dim=-1)[:, :3]
+    tis = score_centering_weight_fn("token", 2.0)
+    correction, q_mass, p_mass = score_centering_correction(head_p, head_q, tis)
+    rho = (1 - q_mass) / (1 - p_mass)
+    alpha = rho * tis(1 / rho)
+    residual = head_q.exp() * tis((head_p - head_q).exp()) - alpha.unsqueeze(-1) * head_p.exp()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(correction, (residual * head_p).sum(-1))

+def _truncated_head(sampler_log_probs, top_p, k):
+    # The head as vLLM's processed log-probs return it under top-p: the kept tokens renormalized
+    # over the support, the remaining slots -inf with arbitrary valid ids.
+    probs, order = torch.sort(sampler_log_probs.exp(), dim=-1, descending=True)
+    keep = (probs.cumsum(-1) - probs) < top_p
+    assert int(keep.sum(-1).max()) <= k
+    sorted_log_probs = sampler_log_probs.gather(-1, order).masked_fill(~keep, float("-inf"))
+    return order[:, :k].to(torch.int32), torch.log_softmax(sorted_log_probs, dim=-1)[:, :k]
+
+
+def _support_mask(ids, head_log_probs, vocab):
+    mask = torch.zeros(ids.shape[0], vocab)
+    return mask.scatter_(1, ids.long(), head_log_probs.isfinite().float()).bool()
+

+    support_sizes = sampler_head.isfinite().sum(-1)

+def test_support_correction_gradient_matches_support_oracle():
+    # Exact centering over the support S: sum_S sg[q w] log p^S with p^S the trainer renormalized on S.
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    vocab, k = 11, 6
+    trainer_logits = torch.randn(3, vocab, requires_grad=True)
+    ids, sampler_head = _truncated_head(torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(3, vocab) * 2, dim=-1), top_p=0.7, k=k)
+    tis = score_centering_weight_fn("token", 2.0)
+    head = topk_log_probs_from_logits(trainer_logits, ids)
+    correction, log_support_mass, _ = score_centering_support_correction(head, sampler_head, tis)
+
+    in_support = _support_mask(ids, sampler_head, vocab)
+    log_p = torch.log_softmax(trainer_logits, dim=-1)
+    log_p_support = torch.log_softmax(log_p.masked_fill(~in_support, float("-inf")), dim=-1)
+    q = torch.zeros(3, vocab).scatter_(1, ids.long(), sampler_head.exp())
+    ratio = torch.where(in_support, (log_p_support - q.log()).exp(), torch.ones_like(q))
+    ref = ((q * tis(ratio)).detach() * log_p_support.masked_fill(~in_support, 0.0)).sum(-1)
+    grad_a = torch.autograd.grad(correction.sum(), trainer_logits, retain_graph=True)[0]
+    grad_b = torch.autograd.grad(ref.sum(), trainer_logits)[0]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(grad_a, grad_b, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(log_support_mass, log_p.masked_fill(~in_support, float("-inf")).logsumexp(-1))
+

+def test_extract_matches_vllm_dict_logprobs():
+    vllm_logprobs = pytest.importorskip("vllm.logprobs")
+    k, num_tokens = 4, 6
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    flat, rows, actions = vllm_logprobs.FlatLogprobs(), [], []
+    for position in range(num_tokens):
+        values, order = torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(32, generator=generator), -1).sort(descending=True)
+        # alternate between a sampled token inside the head and one outside it
+        action = int(order[1] if position % 2 == 0 else order[k + 3])
+        action_value = float(values[(order == action).nonzero().item()])
+        token_ids, log_probs = [action] + order[:k].tolist(), [action_value] + values[:k].tolist()
+        rank = int((values >= action_value).sum())
+        vllm_logprobs.append_logprobs_for_next_position(flat, token_ids, log_probs, [None] * (k + 1), rank, k)
+        vllm_logprobs.append_logprobs_for_next_position(rows, token_ids, log_probs, [None] * (k + 1), rank, k)
+        actions.append(action)
+
+    sampled, ids, log_probs = extract_response_topk_logprobs(flat, k)
+    # vLLM's dict view is what the server read before switching to flat_logprobs
+    assert sampled == [rows[i][actions[i]].logprob for i in range(num_tokens)]
+    head = [sorted((v.rank, t, v.logprob) for t, v in row.items() if v.rank <= k) for row in rows]
+    assert ids.tolist() == [[t for _, t, _ in row] for row in head]
+    assert log_probs.tolist() == [[np.float32(v).item() for _, _, v in row] for row in head]

+async def _generate_with_segments(monkeypatch, segments):
+    from verl.workers.rollout import llm_server
+    from verl.workers.rollout.llm_server import FullyAsyncLLMServerClient
+
+    pending = iter(segments)
+
+    async def fake_generate(self, request_id, *, prompt_ids, **kwargs):
+        return next(pending)
+
+    async def no_wait(_delay, *args, **kwargs):
+        return None
+
+    # generate reaches the upstream through super(), so the base class is patched
+    monkeypatch.setattr(llm_server.LLMServerClient, "generate", fake_generate)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(llm_server.asyncio, "sleep", no_wait)
+    client = FullyAsyncLLMServerClient(config=SimpleNamespace(), load_balancer_handle=None)
+    return await client.generate(request_id="req-0", prompt_ids=[1, 2, 3], sampling_params={})

+def _nested_batch(lengths, k, vocab, top_p=None):
+    rows = [torch.log_softmax(torch.randn(n, vocab) * 2, dim=-1) for n in lengths]
+    if top_p is None:
+        ids = [torch.randint(0, vocab, (n, k), dtype=torch.int32) for n in lengths]
+        log_probs = [row.gather(-1, i.long()) for row, i in zip(rows, ids, strict=True)]
+    else:
+        ids, log_probs = zip(*[_truncated_head(row, top_p, k) for row in rows], strict=True)
+    ids = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(list(ids), layout=torch.jagged)
+    log_probs = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(list(log_probs), layout=torch.jagged)
+    data = TensorDict({"rollout_topk_ids": ids, "rollout_topk_log_probs": log_probs}, batch_size=[len(lengths)])
+    if top_p is not None:
+        # This synthetic provider knows its complete support, independently of head mass.
+        data["rollout_support_complete"] = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(
+            [torch.ones(n, dtype=torch.bool) for n in lengths], layout=torch.jagged

+def gpu_sub_optimizer_state_ids(optimizer):
+    """Collect (object id, device) of the GPU sub-optimizer's Adam-moment state
+    tensors (``exp_avg`` / ``exp_avg_sq``) of an HDO — the tensors that must
+    stay on GPU across offload (issue #8237). ``master_param`` is excluded
+    deliberately: it is a weight shard that ``offload_megatron_copy_params``
+    legitimately offloads."""
+
+    opts = optimizer.chained_optimizers if isinstance(optimizer, ChainedOptimizer) else [optimizer]
+    gpu_state = []
+    for opt in opts:
+        hdo = opt.optimizer
+        for sub in hdo.sub_optimizers:
+            for state in sub.state.values():
+                for k, v in state.items():
+                    if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) and v.is_cuda and k in ("exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
+                        gpu_state.append((id(v), str(v.device)))
+    return gpu_state
+

+
+    With optimizer_cpu_offload=True and optimizer_offload_fraction < 1, the
+    HDO's GPU sub-optimizer (FusedAdam) state must stay on GPU across
+    offload_megatron_optimizer: moving it to CPU corrupts its device assumption
+    and crashes the next fused step. Note: this test requires a Megatron-LM
+    version where building a HybridDeviceOptimizer and stepping it works (on
+    megatron-core 0.16.1, a separate Float16Optimizer param_groups bug blocks
+    the first HDO step)."""
+
+    rendezvous_file = tmp_path / "rdzv_hdo"
+
+    torch.cuda.set_device(0)
+    dist.init_process_group(
+        backend="cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl",
+        init_method=f"file://{rendezvous_file}",
+        rank=0,
+        world_size=1,
+    )

+    model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed(123)

+"""Unit tests for the backend dispatch in verl.utils.attention_utils."""
+
+import sys
+import types
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils import attention_padding_utils, attention_utils
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def reset_resolved_functions():
+    """The resolved functions live in module globals; clear them around each test."""
+    attention_utils._index_first_axis = None
+    attention_utils._pad_input = None
+    attention_utils._rearrange = None
+    attention_utils._unpad_input = None
+    yield
+    attention_utils._index_first_axis = None
+    attention_utils._pad_input = None
+    attention_utils._rearrange = None
+    attention_utils._unpad_input = None
+
+
+def _fake_flash_attn():
+    """A stand-in for the flash_attn package, which has no wheel on non-CUDA devices."""
+    pkg = types.ModuleType("flash_attn")
+    bert_padding = types.ModuleType("flash_attn.bert_padding")
+    for name in ("index_first_axis", "pad_input", "rearrange", "unpad_input"):
+        setattr(bert_padding, name, mock.Mock(name=name, return_value=f"flash_{name}"))
+    pkg.bert_padding = bert_padding
+    return {"flash_attn": pkg, "flash_attn.bert_padding": bert_padding}
+
+
+def test_prefers_flash_attn_when_installed(reset_resolved_functions):
+    """With flash-attn importable, all four entry points dispatch to it."""
+    with (
+        mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_flash_attn()),
+        mock.patch("verl.utils.device.is_torch_npu_available", return_value=False),
+    ):
+        assert attention_utils.index_first_axis() == "flash_index_first_axis"
+        assert attention_utils.pad_input() == "flash_pad_input"
+        assert attention_utils.rearrange() == "flash_rearrange"
+        assert attention_utils.unpad_input() == "flash_unpad_input"
+
+
+def test_falls_back_to_padding_utils_without_flash_attn(reset_resolved_functions):
+    """Without flash-attn, dispatch goes to the pure-torch port rather than a local duplicate."""
+    # A None entry in sys.modules makes `import flash_attn...` raise ImportError.
+    with (
+        mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {"flash_attn": None, "flash_attn.bert_padding": None}),
+        mock.patch("verl.utils.device.is_torch_npu_available", return_value=False),
+    ):
+        index_first_axis, pad_input, rearrange, unpad_input = attention_utils._get_attention_functions()
+
+    assert index_first_axis is attention_padding_utils.index_first_axis
+    assert pad_input is attention_padding_utils.pad_input
+    assert rearrange is attention_padding_utils.rearrange
+    assert unpad_input is attention_padding_utils.unpad_input
+
+
+def test_npu_uses_padding_utils_over_flash_attn(reset_resolved_functions):
+    """NPU keeps its existing behaviour: the port wins even if flash-attn is importable."""
+    with (
+        mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_flash_attn()),
+        mock.patch("verl.utils.device.is_torch_npu_available", return_value=True),
+    ):

+
+    assert index_first_axis is attention_padding_utils.index_first_axis
+
+
+def test_padding_utils_unpad_pad_round_trip():
+    """pad_input(unpad_input(x)) must restore the padded tensor and report correct metadata."""
+    hidden_states = torch.arange(2 * 3 * 4, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 3, 4)
+    attention_mask = torch.tensor([[1, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0]])
+
+    unpadded, indices, cu_seqlens, max_seqlen, seqused = attention_padding_utils.unpad_input(
+        hidden_states, attention_mask
+    )
+
+    assert unpadded.shape == (3, 4)
+    assert max_seqlen == 2
+    torch.testing.assert_close(cu_seqlens, torch.tensor([0, 2, 3], dtype=torch.int32))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(seqused, torch.tensor([2, 1], dtype=torch.int32))
+
+    repadded = attention_padding_utils.pad_input(unpadded, indices, batch=2, seqlen=3)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(repadded, hidden_states * attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1))
+
+
+def test_padding_utils_index_first_axis_is_differentiable():
+    """index_first_axis is an autograd.Function; gradients must flow back to the unselected rows."""
+    tensor = torch.randn(4, 3, requires_grad=True)

+
+    expected = torch.zeros(4, 3)
+    expected[indices] = 1.0

+DEVICE = "npu"

+def _synchronize():

+def _torch_ce_logprobs_entropy(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    labels: torch.Tensor,
+    temperature: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Reference: matmul + CE logprobs + token entropy (fp32 accumulate)."""
+    h = hidden.reshape(-1, hidden.shape[-1]).float()
+    w = weight.float()
+    logits = torch.matmul(h, w.T) / temperature
+    logprobs = -torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, labels.reshape(-1), reduction="none")
+    pd = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
+    entropy = torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=-1) - (pd * logits).sum(dim=-1)
+    return logprobs, entropy
+
+
+def _make_inputs(
+    num_tokens: int,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    vocab_size: int,
+    *,
+    temperature: float = 1.0,
+    seed: int = 0,
+    batched: bool = False,
+):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    if batched:
+        hidden = torch.empty(1, num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE).uniform_(-0.5, 0.5)
+        labels = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (1, num_tokens), device=DEVICE)
+    else:
+        hidden = torch.empty(num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE).uniform_(-0.5, 0.5)
+        labels = torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (num_tokens,), device=DEVICE)
+    weight = torch.empty(vocab_size, hidden_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE).uniform_(-0.5, 0.5)
+    hidden = hidden.requires_grad_()
+    weight = weight.requires_grad_()
+    return hidden, weight, labels, temperature
+
+

+def test_compute_quant_thd_align_size(monkeypatch):

+    assert mcore_util._compute_quant_thd_align_size(1, 16) == (16, 128)

+    # mxfp8 scales in 32-element blocks: per-seq lcm(32, align).
+    assert mcore_util._compute_quant_thd_align_size(1, 32) == (32, 128)

+# Top-k distillation packs the teacher tensors itself and asserts that they line up with the student logits,
+# which come from inputs packed with the low-precision padding.
+
+_DISTILLATION_CONFIG = SimpleNamespace(distillation_loss=SimpleNamespace(log_prob_min_clamp=-20.0, tail_mass_eps=1e-6))
+
+
+def _load_megatron_distillation_losses(monkeypatch, mcore_util):
+    # the losses module packs with verl.models.mcore.util: use the copy loaded against stubbed megatron
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "verl.models.mcore.util", mcore_util)
+    path = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "verl" / "trainer" / "distillation" / "megatron" / "losses.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("megatron_distillation_losses_quant_padding", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+
+    class _ShapeOnlyKL:
+        """Stands in for the vocab-parallel KL, which needs TP groups: these tests check the packing."""
+
+        @staticmethod
+        def apply(student_logits, *_args):
+            return (torch.zeros(student_logits.shape[:2]),) * 6
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_VocabParallelKLDivergence", _ShapeOnlyKL)
+    return module
+
+
+def _nested(seqlens, *dense_shape, dtype=torch.float32):
+    return torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(
+        [torch.zeros(n, *dense_shape, dtype=dtype) for n in seqlens], layout=torch.jagged
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "seqlen, quant_align_size, rows",

+        (16, 32, 256),  # mxfp8: eight 16-token sequences, each padded to 32 rows: 256 rows against 128 unpadded
+        (17, 16, 256),  # the gap predates MXFP8: under the 16-token FP8 recipes, 17 tokens pad to 32 rows
+    ],
+)
+def test_distillation_topk_thd_packs_teacher_with_the_student_padding(monkeypatch, seqlen, quant_align_size, rows):

+    seqlens = [seqlen] * 8
+
+    student_ids, *_ = mcore_util.preprocess_thd_engine(
+        _nested(seqlens, dtype=torch.long), pre_process=True, quant_align_size=quant_align_size
+    )
+    assert student_ids.shape[:2] == (1, rows)
+    student_logits = torch.zeros(1, rows, 4)
+    teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids = _nested(seqlens, 2), _nested(seqlens, 2, dtype=torch.long)
+
+    outputs = losses.compute_forward_kl_topk(
+        student_logits,
+        teacher_log_probs,
+        teacher_ids,

+        quant_align_size=quant_align_size,
+    )
+    assert outputs["distillation_losses"].shape == (1, rows)
+
+    # without the student's padding the teacher tensors have 8 * seqlen rows
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        losses.compute_forward_kl_topk(student_logits, teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids, _DISTILLATION_CONFIG, "thd")

+# The teacher's rows must hold the same tokens as the student's rows, not only the same number of rows: the tests below
+# mark every token with its own number (0 is padding) and compare the rows the KL receives with the student's rows.
+
+
+def _marked(seqlens, *dense_shape, dtype=torch.long):
+    """Nested tensor in which every token holds its own number (1, 2, ... across the batch) in all its entries."""
+    rows, start = [], 1
+    for n in seqlens:
+        tokens = torch.arange(start, start + n).to(dtype)
+        rows.append(tokens.reshape(n, *[1] * len(dense_shape)).expand(n, *dense_shape).clone())
+        start += n
+    return torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(rows, layout=torch.jagged)
+
+
+def _teacher_rows_seen_by_the_kl(monkeypatch, losses):
+    seen = {}
+
+    class _RecordingKL:
+        @staticmethod
+        def apply(student_logits, teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids, *_args):
+            seen["log_probs"], seen["ids"] = teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids
+            return (torch.zeros(student_logits.shape[:2]),) * 6
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(losses, "_VocabParallelKLDivergence", _RecordingKL)
+    return seen
+
+
+def _pack_student_and_teacher(monkeypatch, mcore_util, seqlens, **packing):
+    """Packs the student's tokens and runs the top-k loss with the same packing; returns the student rows and what the
+    KL received."""
+    losses = _load_megatron_distillation_losses(monkeypatch, mcore_util)
+    seen = _teacher_rows_seen_by_the_kl(monkeypatch, losses)
+    student_tokens, *_ = mcore_util.preprocess_thd_engine(_marked(seqlens), pre_process=True, **packing)
+    teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids = _marked(seqlens, 2, dtype=torch.float32), _marked(seqlens, 2)
+    student_logits = torch.zeros(*student_tokens.shape, 4)
+    losses.compute_forward_kl_topk(
+        student_logits, teacher_log_probs, teacher_ids, _DISTILLATION_CONFIG, "thd", **packing
+    )
+    return student_tokens, seen
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("seqlen", [17, 32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("quant_align_size", [None, 16, 32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_rank", [0, 1])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cp_layout", ["zigzag", "contiguous"])
+def test_distillation_topk_thd_teacher_rows_hold_the_student_tokens(
+    monkeypatch, cp_layout, cp_rank, quant_align_size, seqlen
+):
+    mcore_util = _load_mcore_util_with_stubbed_megatron(monkeypatch, tp_size=1, cp_size=2, cp_rank=cp_rank)
+    student_tokens, seen = _pack_student_and_teacher(
+        monkeypatch, mcore_util, [seqlen] * 16, quant_align_size=quant_align_size, cp_layout=cp_layout
+    )
+    for k in range(2):
+        assert torch.equal(seen["ids"][..., k], student_tokens)
+        assert torch.equal(seen["log_probs"][..., k], student_tokens.to(torch.float32))
+

+def test_distillation_topk_thd_teacher_split_zigzag_against_a_contiguous_student_misaligns_rows(monkeypatch):
+    """What the CP layout prevents: the student split contiguously (dsv4_hybrid), the teacher with the zigzag default.
+    The shapes agree, so the assertion in the loss passes, but most rows belong to other tokens."""
+    mcore_util = _load_mcore_util_with_stubbed_megatron(monkeypatch, tp_size=1, cp_size=2, cp_rank=0)
+    seqlens = [17] * 16
+    student_tokens, *_ = mcore_util.preprocess_thd_engine(
+        _marked(seqlens), pre_process=True, quant_align_size=32, cp_layout="contiguous"
+    )
+    _, seen = _pack_student_and_teacher(monkeypatch, mcore_util, seqlens, quant_align_size=32, cp_layout="zigzag")
+    teacher_tokens = seen["ids"][..., 0]
+    valid = student_tokens != 0
+    assert teacher_tokens.shape == student_tokens.shape == (1, 256)
+    assert int(valid.sum()) == 136
+    assert int((teacher_tokens[valid] != student_tokens[valid]).sum()) == 128

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("group_rank", [0, 1])

+def test_distillation_topk_thd_teacher_rows_follow_the_dynamic_cp_group(monkeypatch, cp_layout, group_rank):
+    """Dynamic CP packs a micro-batch over a group of local_cp_size ranks (2 here), not the whole CP group (4)."""
+    mcore_util = _load_mcore_util_with_stubbed_megatron(monkeypatch, tp_size=1, cp_size=4, cp_rank=3)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "get_rank", lambda group=None: group_rank)
+    seqlens = [17] * 16
+    student_tokens, seen = _pack_student_and_teacher(
+        monkeypatch, mcore_util, seqlens, quant_align_size=32, cp_layout=cp_layout, local_cp_size=2
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(seen["ids"][..., 0], student_tokens)

+"""The FP8 refit staging predicate must see kernel repacks that keep the checkpoint shape.
+
+vLLM's FlashInfer MoE preps hand ``replace_parameter`` a rewritten copy of ``w13`` (and its block
+scale) with the checkpoint's shape and dtype: CUTLASS swaps the gate/up halves, TRT-LLM's MXFP8
+path interleaves and tile-shuffles the rows. ``_layer_needs_fp8_staging`` compared shape, dtype
+and ``is_shuffled`` only, so such a layer was never staged on a refit: the sync wrote canonical
+weights straight into the repacked live buffer and ``process_weights_after_loading`` never re-ran
+(first seen on 1xB200 with vLLM 0.24: the MoE refit probe read rel err 1.739 at the first sync).
+
+``vllm_fp8_utils`` is loaded by path against a stub ``vllm...quantization.fp8`` module, so these
+run without vLLM.
+"""
+
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+from packaging import version
+
+_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+_FP8_MODULE = "vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.fp8"
+E, INTER, HID = 2, 32, 64
+
+
+def _load_fp8_utils():
+    path = _REPO_ROOT / "verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp8_utils.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vllm_fp8_utils_under_test", path)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _fp8():
+    return sys.modules[_FP8_MODULE]
+
+
+def _swap_halves(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """FlashInfer's W13 -> W31 swap: a new tensor with the same shape and dtype."""
+    return t.reshape(t.shape[0], 2, t.shape[1] // 2, *t.shape[2:]).flip(1).reshape(t.shape).contiguous()
+
+
+def _cutlass_like_process(self, layer):
+    """FlashInfer CUTLASS block-FP8 prep: gate/up halves of w13 and its scale swapped, shapes kept."""
+    layer._process_calls = getattr(layer, "_process_calls", 0) + 1
+    _fp8().replace_parameter(layer, "w13_weight", _swap_halves(layer.w13_weight.data))
+    _fp8().replace_parameter(layer, "w13_weight_scale_inv", _swap_halves(layer.w13_weight_scale_inv.data))
+    # what vLLM's _setup_kernel captures right after the replace calls
+    layer._kernel_refs = (layer.w13_weight, layer.w13_weight_scale_inv)
+
+
+def _identity_process(self, layer):
+    """A backend that keeps the checkpoint layout (Triton / vLLM-CUTLASS): replace with the same tensor."""
+    for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight", "w13_weight_scale_inv", "w2_weight_scale_inv"):
+        _fp8().replace_parameter(layer, name, getattr(layer, name))
+
+
+def _repacking_process(self, layer):
+    """A backend that changes the scale's shape (DeepGEMM-like): the pre-existing detection path."""
+    _fp8().replace_parameter(layer, "w13_weight_scale_inv", layer.w13_weight_scale_inv.data.reshape(E, -1).clone())
+
+
+def _direct_repacking_process(self, layer):
+    """MXFP8-linear-like prep that assigns a same-layout replacement without replace_parameter."""
+    layer.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(_swap_halves(layer.w13_weight.data), requires_grad=False)
+
+
+class _StubVllmFp8:
+    NAMES = (
+        "vllm",
+        "vllm.model_executor",
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers",
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization",
+        _FP8_MODULE,
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, moe_process):
+        self._moe_process = moe_process
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        self._saved = {n: sys.modules.get(n) for n in self.NAMES}
+        mods = {n: types.ModuleType(n) for n in self.NAMES}
+        fp8 = mods[_FP8_MODULE]
+
+        def replace_parameter(layer, name, new_data, prefer_copy=False):
+            setattr(layer, name, torch.nn.Parameter(new_data, requires_grad=False))
+
+        fp8.replace_parameter = replace_parameter
+        fp8.Fp8LinearMethod = type("Fp8LinearMethod", (), {"process_weights_after_loading": lambda self, layer: None})
+        fp8.Fp8MoEMethod = type("Fp8MoEMethod", (), {"process_weights_after_loading": self._moe_process})
+        sys.modules.update(mods)
+        self.fp8 = fp8
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *exc):
+        for name, prev in self._saved.items():
+            if prev is None:
+                sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+            else:
+                sys.modules[name] = prev
+
+
+class _FakeRoutedExperts(torch.nn.Module):
+    """vLLM RoutedExperts stand-in under block FP8: fused expert weights plus ``*_scale_inv`` block scales."""
+
+    def __init__(self, quant_method):
+        super().__init__()
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+        self.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.randint(-6, 7, (E, 2 * INTER, HID), generator=g).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.w2_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.randint(-6, 7, (E, HID, INTER), generator=g).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.w13_weight_scale_inv = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.rand(E, 2, 1, generator=g), requires_grad=False)
+        self.w2_weight_scale_inv = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.rand(E, 1, 1, generator=g), requires_grad=False)
+        self.quant_method = quant_method
+
+
+def _loaded_layer(module, stub):
+    """Build the layer and run vLLM's post-load hook once, as the initial model load does."""
+    layer = _FakeRoutedExperts(stub.fp8.Fp8MoEMethod())
+    layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.experts = layer
+    return model, layer
+
+
+def test_same_shape_repack_is_restaged_and_reprocessed_into_the_live_storage():
+    module = _load_fp8_utils()
+    with _StubVllmFp8(_cutlass_like_process) as stub:
+        patchers = module.build_fp8_method_patchers(version.parse("0.24.0"))
+        assert len(patchers) == 2
+        for p in patchers:
+            p.start()
+        try:
+            layer = _FakeRoutedExperts(stub.fp8.Fp8MoEMethod())
+            canonical = layer.w13_weight.data.clone()
+            layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)  # initial load
+            assert tuple(layer.w13_weight.shape) == (E, 2 * INTER, HID)  # shape and dtype unchanged: the blind spot
+            assert torch.equal(layer.w13_weight.data.view(torch.uint8), _swap_halves(canonical).view(torch.uint8))
+            assert layer._verl_fp8_repacked == {"w13_weight", "w13_weight_scale_inv"}
+            live_w, live_s = layer.w13_weight, layer.w13_weight_scale_inv
+            model = torch.nn.Module()
+            model.experts = layer
+
+            staged = module.stage_fp8_params_for_loading(model)
+            assert staged == [layer], "a same-shape repack must still be staged"
+            fresh = torch.randint(-6, 7, canonical.shape).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            fresh_scale = torch.rand(E, 2, 1)
+            layer.w13_weight.data.copy_(fresh)  # what load_weights writes: checkpoint layout
+            layer.w13_weight_scale_inv.data.copy_(fresh_scale)
+            module.process_fp8_weights_after_loading(staged)
+
+            assert layer._process_calls == 2, "the refit must re-run the kernel prep"
+            assert layer.w13_weight is live_w and layer.w13_weight.data_ptr() == live_w.data_ptr()
+            assert torch.equal(layer.w13_weight.data.view(torch.uint8), _swap_halves(fresh).view(torch.uint8))
+            assert torch.equal(layer.w13_weight_scale_inv.data, _swap_halves(fresh_scale))
+            # the kernel captured right after the replace calls points at the live params, not staging buffers
+            assert layer._kernel_refs[0] is live_w and layer._kernel_refs[1] is live_s
+        finally:
+            for p in patchers:
+                p.stop()
+
+
+def test_layout_keeping_backend_is_not_staged():
+    module = _load_fp8_utils()
+    with _StubVllmFp8(_identity_process) as stub:
+        patchers = module.build_fp8_method_patchers(version.parse("0.24.0"))
+        for p in patchers:
+            p.start()
+        try:
+            model, layer = _loaded_layer(module, stub)
+            assert not getattr(layer, "_verl_fp8_repacked", None)
+            assert module.stage_fp8_params_for_loading(model) == []
+        finally:
+            for p in patchers:
+                p.stop()
+
+
+def test_shape_changing_repack_is_still_staged():
+    module = _load_fp8_utils()
+    with _StubVllmFp8(_repacking_process) as stub:
+        patchers = module.build_fp8_method_patchers(version.parse("0.24.0"))
+        for p in patchers:
+            p.start()
+        try:
+            model, layer = _loaded_layer(module, stub)
+            assert tuple(layer.w13_weight_scale_inv.shape) == (E, 2)
+            assert module.stage_fp8_params_for_loading(model) == [layer]
+        finally:
+            for p in patchers:
+                p.stop()
+
+
+def test_direct_same_shape_parameter_replacement_is_restaged():
+    module = _load_fp8_utils()
+    with _StubVllmFp8(_direct_repacking_process) as stub:
+        patchers = module.build_fp8_method_patchers(version.parse("0.24.0"))
+        for p in patchers:
+            p.start()
+        try:
+            model, layer = _loaded_layer(module, stub)
+            assert layer._verl_fp8_repacked == {"w13_weight"}
+            assert module.stage_fp8_params_for_loading(model) == [layer]
+        finally:
+            for p in patchers:
+                p.stop()

+import importlib.util

+
+import torch
+
+_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+
+
+def _load_fp4_utils():
+    path = _REPO_ROOT / "verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp4_utils.py"

+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)

+
+
+_FP4_UTILS = _load_fp4_utils()
+_MXFP4_LIVE_ATTR = _FP4_UTILS._MXFP4_LIVE_ATTR
+_NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR = _FP4_UTILS._NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR
+_restore_nvfp4_input_scales_in_place = _FP4_UTILS._restore_nvfp4_input_scales_in_place
+_restore_nvfp4_kernel_config_in_place = _FP4_UTILS._restore_nvfp4_kernel_config_in_place
+_stage_mxfp4_moe_params = _FP4_UTILS._stage_mxfp4_moe_params
+_stage_nvfp4_moe_params = _FP4_UTILS._stage_nvfp4_moe_params
+
+
+class _PackedMxfp4Method:
+    _verl_uses_packed_checkpoint_names = True
+    num_experts = 2
+    intermediate_size = 32
+    hidden_size = 32
+
+
+def test_compressed_tensors_mxfp4_restage_exposes_packed_weight_names():
+    module = torch.nn.Module()
+    module.quant_method = _PackedMxfp4Method()
+    module.weight_loader = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
+    module.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 1, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 1, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+
+    live_w13 = module.w13_weight
+    live_w2 = module.w2_weight
+    _stage_mxfp4_moe_params(module)
+
+    assert module.w13_weight is live_w13
+    assert module.w2_weight is live_w2
+    assert module.w13_weight_packed.data_ptr() == live_w13.data_ptr()
+    assert module.w2_weight_packed.data_ptr() == live_w2.data_ptr()
+    assert module.w13_weight_packed.weight_loader == module.weight_loader
+    assert getattr(module, _MXFP4_LIVE_ATTR)["w13_weight"] is live_w13
+    assert getattr(module, _MXFP4_LIVE_ATTR)["w2_weight"] is live_w2
+    assert module.w13_weight_scale.quant_method == "block"
+    assert module.w2_weight_scale.quant_method == "block"

+
+class _Nvfp4Moe:
+    is_act_and_mul = True
+
+
+class _Nvfp4Method:
+    moe = _Nvfp4Moe()

+
+def test_compressed_tensors_nvfp4_restage_exposes_checkpoint_layout():
+    module = torch.nn.Module()
+    module.quant_method = _Nvfp4Method()
+    module.weight_loader = lambda *args, **kwargs: None
+    module.num_experts = 2
+    module.intermediate_size_per_partition = 32
+    module.hidden_size = 32
+    module.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 16, dtype=torch.uint8), requires_grad=False)
+    # CUTLASS swizzles/pads scales; use checkpoint shape here to exercise the
+    # same-storage path without requiring CUDA.
+    module.w13_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 64, 2, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 32, 2, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_weight_scale_2 = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight_scale_2 = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_weight_global_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_weight_global_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_input_global_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w2_input_global_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2), requires_grad=False)
+    module.w13_input_scale = torch.ones(2)
+    module.w2_input_scale = torch.ones(2)

+    live_w13 = module.w13_weight

+    _stage_nvfp4_moe_params(module)
+
+    assert module.w13_weight_packed.data_ptr() == live_w13.data_ptr()
+    assert module.w13_weight_global_scale is live_global
+    assert module.w13_weight_scale.quant_method == "group"
+    assert getattr(module, _NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR)["w13_weight"] is live_w13
+    assert "w13_weight_scale_2" in getattr(module, _NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR)
+    assert getattr(module, _NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR)["w13_input_scale"] is live_input_scale

+def test_nvfp4_restage_updates_activation_scales_without_changing_addresses():
+    module = torch.nn.Module()
+    live_w13 = torch.zeros(2)
+    live_w2 = torch.zeros(2)
+    setattr(
+        module,
+        _NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR,
+        {"w13_input_scale": live_w13, "w2_input_scale": live_w2},

+    converted = [None] * 8
+    converted[3] = torch.tensor([2.0, 3.0])
+    converted[7] = torch.tensor([4.0, 5.0])

+    result = _restore_nvfp4_input_scales_in_place(module, converted)

+    assert result[3] is live_w13

+    torch.testing.assert_close(live_w2, torch.tensor([4.0, 5.0]))
+    assert getattr(module, _NVFP4_LIVE_ATTR) == {}

+def test_nvfp4_restage_retains_kernel_config_and_updates_derived_scales():
+    module = torch.nn.Module()
+    module.w13_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2))
+    module.w2_weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2))

+    retained_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        g1_alphas=module.w13_weight_scale_2,
+        g2_alphas=module.w2_weight_scale_2,
+        w1_scale=module.w13_weight_scale,
+        w2_scale=module.w2_weight_scale,
+        a1_gscale=torch.zeros(2),
+        a2_gscale=torch.zeros(2),
+    )
+    retained_kernel = SimpleNamespace(fused_experts=SimpleNamespace(quant_config=retained_config))
+    processing_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        a1_gscale=1.0 / module.w13_input_scale,
+        a2_gscale=1.0 / module.w2_input_scale,
+    )
+    module.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(moe_kernel=SimpleNamespace(), moe_quant_config=processing_config)
+
+    _restore_nvfp4_kernel_config_in_place(module, retained_kernel, retained_config)
+
+    assert module.quant_method.moe_kernel is retained_kernel
+    assert module.quant_method.moe_quant_config is retained_config
+    torch.testing.assert_close(retained_config.a1_gscale, torch.tensor([2.0, 4.0]))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(retained_config.a2_gscale, torch.tensor([5.0, 10.0]))

+"""A refit must reach unquantized MoE layers whose kernel prep reshaped the expert weights.
+
+FlashInfer TRT-LLM -- vLLM's default bf16 MoE backend on SM100 -- keeps ``w13_weight`` /
+``w2_weight`` in a 4-D block layout, so the refit's per-expert checkpoint-layout loads do not
+fit the live parameters (verl-project/verl#7978). ``vllm_unquant_utils`` stages the checkpoint
+layout as a view over the live storage and folds the re-derived kernel layout back into it.
+
+The kernel prep here is a toy block transpose with the same property that matters: a new shape
+over the same bytes, reordered so that converting in place would corrupt it. The module is loaded
+by path against stub vLLM modules, so these run without vLLM.
+"""
+
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+import types
+import weakref
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+_REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+_FUSED_MOE_PKG = "vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe"
+_UNQUANTIZED_MODULE = f"{_FUSED_MOE_PKG}.unquantized_fused_moe_method"
+_LAYERWISE_MODULE = "vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload.layerwise"
+E, INTER, HID, BLOCK = 2, 4, 8, 4
+
+
+def _load_by_path(name, relpath):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, _REPO_ROOT / relpath)
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _load_unquant_utils():
+    fp8_utils = _load_by_path("vllm_fp8_utils_for_unquant_utils", "verl/utils/vllm/vllm_fp8_utils.py")
+    saved = sys.modules.get("verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils")
+    sys.modules["verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils"] = fp8_utils
+    try:
+        return _load_by_path("vllm_unquant_utils_under_test", "verl/utils/vllm/vllm_unquant_utils.py")
+    finally:
+        if saved is None:
+            sys.modules.pop("verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils", None)
+        else:
+            sys.modules["verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils"] = saved
+
+
+unquant_utils = _load_unquant_utils()
+
+
+def _block_layout(raw: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[E, R, C] -> [E, C/B, R, B]: TRT-LLM's BlockMajorK in miniature (new shape, same bytes)."""
+    e, r, c = raw.shape
+    return raw.reshape(e, r, c // BLOCK, BLOCK).permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
+
+
+def _padded_block_layout(raw: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pad before the block transpose, as vLLM 0.29 pads TRT-LLM's intermediate dim to a multiple of 128."""
+    return _block_layout(torch.nn.functional.pad(raw, (0, BLOCK)))
+
+
+def _halved_layout(raw: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A kernel layout with fewer bytes than the checkpoint layout: no room to stage in place."""
+    return raw[..., ::2].contiguous()
+
+
+def _replace_parameter(layer, param_name, new_data, prefer_copy=False):
+    """vLLM's ``replace_parameter``: copy into the old parameter only when shape and dtype match."""
+    old = getattr(layer, param_name, None)
+    if prefer_copy and old is not None and old.shape == new_data.shape and old.dtype == new_data.dtype:
+        old.copy_(new_data)
+        return
+    new_param = torch.nn.Parameter(new_data, requires_grad=False)
+    if old is not None and hasattr(old, "weight_loader"):
+        new_param.weight_loader = old.weight_loader
+    setattr(layer, param_name, new_param)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def vllm(monkeypatch):
+    """Stub vLLM's unquantized MoE method module and the per-layer metadata it records at model init."""
+    unquantized = types.ModuleType(_UNQUANTIZED_MODULE)
+    unquantized.replace_parameter = _replace_parameter
+
+    class UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod:
+        """``process_weights_after_loading`` as vLLM's ``_setup_kernel`` does it: kernel prep, then
+        ``replace_parameter`` through the module-level name, copying into place on a weight update."""
+
+        def __init__(self, kernel_layout=_block_layout, names=("w13_weight", "w2_weight")):
+            self.kernel_layout = kernel_layout
+            self.names = names
+            self.moe_kernel = None
+
+        def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer):
+            is_weight_update = self.moe_kernel is not None
+            for name in self.names:
+                new_data = self.kernel_layout(getattr(layer, name).data)
+                unquantized.replace_parameter(layer, name, new_data, prefer_copy=is_weight_update)
+            if not is_weight_update:
+                self.moe_kernel = (layer.w13_weight, layer.w2_weight)
+
+    unquantized.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod = UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod
+    fused_moe = types.ModuleType(_FUSED_MOE_PKG)
+    fused_moe.unquantized_fused_moe_method = unquantized
+    layerwise = types.ModuleType(_LAYERWISE_MODULE)
+    layerwise.LAYERWISE_INFO = weakref.WeakKeyDictionary()
+
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, _FUSED_MOE_PKG, fused_moe)
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, _UNQUANTIZED_MODULE, unquantized)
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, _LAYERWISE_MODULE, layerwise)
+    return types.SimpleNamespace(unquantized=unquantized, layerwise_info=layerwise.LAYERWISE_INFO)
+

+class _FakeRoutedExperts(torch.nn.Module):
+    """vLLM ``RoutedExperts`` stand-in: fused bf16 expert weights and a per-expert weight loader."""
+
+    def __init__(self, quant_method, seed=0):
+        super().__init__()
+        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+        w13 = torch.randn(E, 2 * INTER, HID, generator=g).bfloat16()
+        w2 = torch.randn(E, HID, INTER, generator=g).bfloat16()
+        self.w13_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(w13, requires_grad=False)
+        self.w2_weight = torch.nn.Parameter(w2, requires_grad=False)
+        for param in (self.w13_weight, self.w2_weight):
+            param.weight_loader = self.weight_loader
+        self.quant_method = quant_method
+
+    def weight_loader(self, param, loaded_weight, expert_id):
+        param.data[expert_id].copy_(loaded_weight)
+
+
+def _engine_init(vllm, layers):
+    """Model init as vLLM runs it: record the checkpoint layout, then load and run the kernel prep."""
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.layers = torch.nn.ModuleList(layers)
+    for layer in layers:
+        params = {name: getattr(layer, name).data.to("meta") for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")}
+        vllm.layerwise_info[layer] = types.SimpleNamespace(restore_metadata=(params, {}))
+        layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+    return model
+
+
+def _new_weights(seed):
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": torch.randn(E, 2 * INTER, HID, generator=g).bfloat16(),
+        "w2_weight": torch.randn(E, HID, INTER, generator=g).bfloat16(),
+    }
+
+
+def _load(layer, weights):
+    """The refit's per-expert loads, through whatever parameter is on the layer (``params_dict``)."""
+    for name, tensor in weights.items():
+        param = getattr(layer, name)
+        for expert_id in range(E):
+            param.weight_loader(param, tensor[expert_id], expert_id)
+

+def test_block_layout_is_staged_as_a_view_and_folded_back_into_the_same_storage(vllm):
+    layer = _FakeRoutedExperts(vllm.unquantized.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod())
+    model = _engine_init(vllm, [layer])
+    live = {name: getattr(layer, name) for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")}
+    assert live["w13_weight"].shape == (E, HID // BLOCK, 2 * INTER, BLOCK)
+
+    staged = unquant_utils.stage_unquantized_moe_params(model)
+
+    assert staged == [layer]
+    checkpoint, _ = vllm.layerwise_info[layer].restore_metadata
+    for name, param in live.items():
+        view = getattr(layer, name)
+        assert view is not param
+        assert view.shape == checkpoint[name].shape
+        assert view.data_ptr() == param.data_ptr(), "the staging view must reuse the live storage"
+        assert view.weight_loader == param.weight_loader
+
+    weights = _new_weights(seed=1)
+    _load(layer, weights)
+    # The loads went straight into the live storage, in checkpoint layout.
+    for name, param in live.items():
+        assert torch.equal(param.data.reshape(-1), weights[name].reshape(-1))
+
+    with unquant_utils.fold_unquantized_moe_params(staged):
+        layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+
+    assert vllm.unquantized.replace_parameter is _replace_parameter
+    assert not hasattr(layer, unquant_utils._LIVE_ATTR)
+    for name, param in live.items():
+        assert getattr(layer, name) is param, "the live parameter object must be back on the layer"
+        assert torch.equal(param.data, _block_layout(weights[name]))
+

+def test_each_layer_is_folded_before_the_next_is_processed(vllm):
+    """The re-derived weights land in the live storage inside the layer's own post-load hook, so its
+    temporary has no owner left by the time the next layer allocates one: one layer's worth at a time."""
+    layers = [_FakeRoutedExperts(vllm.unquantized.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod(), seed=i) for i in range(3)]
+    model = _engine_init(vllm, layers)
+    live = [{name: getattr(layer, name) for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")} for layer in layers]
+    staged = unquant_utils.stage_unquantized_moe_params(model)
+    weights = [_new_weights(seed=10 + i) for i in range(len(layers))]
+    for layer, new in zip(layers, weights, strict=True):
+        _load(layer, new)
+
+    # vLLM's loop runs every module's post-load hook inside the one fold.
+    with unquant_utils.fold_unquantized_moe_params(staged):
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+            for name, param in live[i].items():
+                assert getattr(layer, name) is param, f"layer {i} was not folded before the next layer"
+                assert torch.equal(param.data, _block_layout(weights[i][name]))
+

+    layers = [

+class _QueuedEngine(_FakeEngine):
+    """Engine whose requests land in the (fake) scheduler but are never scheduled.
+
+    Models a request stuck in vLLM's WAITING queue because the batch is larger than
+    max_num_seqs: add_request() returns immediately, but no output is ever produced
+    until pause_generation(abort) finishes the request.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.queues: dict[str, asyncio.Queue] = {}
+        self.aborted: list[str] = []
+        self.engine_aborts: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []
+
+    async def add_request(self, request_id, prompt, params, **kwargs):
+        q = asyncio.Queue()
+        self.queues[request_id] = q
+        self.output_processor.request_states[request_id] = object()
+
+        engine = self
+        internal_id = f"{request_id}-internal"  # vLLM's internal request id, which differs from the caller's
+
+        class _Collector:
+            request_id = internal_id
+
+            def get_nowait(self_inner):
+                try:
+                    return q.get_nowait()
+                except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
+                    return None
+
+            async def get(self_inner):
+                return await q.get()
+
+            def close(self_inner):
+                engine.closed += 1
+
+        return _Collector()
+
+    async def pause_generation(self, **kwargs):
+        await super().pause_generation(**kwargs)
+        # abort mode: every in-flight request finishes with an empty output.
+        for rid, q in self.queues.items():
+            self.aborted.append(rid)
+            q.put_nowait(SimpleNamespace(finished=True, outputs=[]))
+        self.output_processor.request_states.clear()
+
+    async def abort(self, request_id, internal=False):
+        self.engine_aborts.append((request_id, internal))
+
+
+def _make_queued_server():
+    server = _make_server()
+    server.engine = _QueuedEngine()
+    server.engine.server = server
+    return server
+

+def test_abort_is_not_blocked_by_requests_waiting_for_their_first_token():
+    # Regression: the barrier used to be released on the first *token*, so requests parked
+    # in the scheduler's WAITING queue held _admitting > 0 and abort_all_requests() could
+    # not pause the engine until every one of them had been scheduled and prefilled.
+    async def main():
+        server = _make_queued_server()
+
+        async def submit(rid):
+            assert await server._park_until_admitted(rid) is None
+            return await server._generate_admitted(
+                prompt={"prompt_token_ids": [1]},
+                sampling_params=SimpleNamespace(),
+                request_id=rid,
+                lora_request=None,
+                priority=0,
+            )
+
+        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(submit(f"r{i}")) for i in range(8)]
+        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
+
+        assert server._admitting == 0, "barrier must be released once add_request returns"
+        assert len(server.engine.queues) == 8, "all requests reached the engine"
+        assert not any(t.done() for t in tasks), "requests are still waiting for tokens"
+
+        await asyncio.wait_for(server.abort_all_requests(), timeout=1)
+
+        assert server.engine.pause_calls == 1
+        assert server.engine.admitting_at_pause == 0
+        results = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(*tasks), timeout=1)
+        assert all(r.finished and r.outputs == [] for r in results), "aborted requests return empty"
+        assert sorted(server.engine.aborted) == sorted(f"r{i}" for i in range(8))
+        # Requests that finish normally close their collectors and are not aborted again.
+        assert server.engine.closed == 8 and server.engine.engine_aborts == []
+        assert server._admitting == 0
+
+    asyncio.run(main())

+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("top_k,top_p", [(16, 1.0), (64, 0.9), (-1, 0.9), (-1, 1.0)])
+def test_processed_topk_support_evidence(llm, top_k, top_p):
+    k = 64
+    params = SamplingParams(temperature=1.0, top_p=top_p, top_k=top_k, max_tokens=32, logprobs=k, flat_logprobs=True)
+    outputs = llm.generate(["Write one short sentence about sampling.", "List three prime numbers."], params)
+    complete_rows = 0
+    for output in outputs:
+        completion = output.outputs[0]
+        sampled, ids, log_probs, complete = extract_response_topk_logprobs_with_coverage(
+            completion.logprobs, k, vocab_size=llm.llm_engine.model_config.get_vocab_size()
+        )
+        in_support = np.isfinite(log_probs)
+        # A partial head with all finite entries is unknown, even if its mass rounds to one.
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(complete, in_support.sum(-1) < k)
+        complete_rows += int(complete.sum())
+        np.testing.assert_allclose(np.exp(log_probs[complete]).sum(-1), 1.0, atol=1e-3)
+        for t, token_id in enumerate(completion.token_ids):
+            slots = np.nonzero((ids[t] == token_id) & in_support[t])[0]
+            if complete[t]:
+                assert slots.size == 1, f"sampled token {token_id} is outside a proven complete head at position {t}"
+            if slots.size:
+                np.testing.assert_allclose(sampled[t], log_probs[t, slots[0]], atol=1e-5)
+    if top_k == 16:
+        assert complete_rows > 0
+    if top_k == -1 and top_p == 1.0:
+        assert complete_rows == 0

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("k,expected_complete", [(2, False), (4, True)])
+def test_small_decode_batch_provider_support_coverage(k, expected_complete):
+    # vLLM 0.29 retains both cutoff ties, while 0.32 keeps exactly top_k entries.
+    # Either way, an all-finite partial head does not prove complete support.
+    logits = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0]], device="cuda")
+    logits = apply_top_k_top_p(logits, torch.tensor([2], device="cuda"), None)
+    log_probs = logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    support_ids = log_probs[0].isfinite().nonzero().flatten().tolist()
+    assert len(support_ids) in (2, 3)
+    head, ids = log_probs.topk(k, -1)
+    # When 0.29 retains the cutoff tie, sample the omitted support member. Otherwise
+    # sample from the recorded head; duplicated sampled/top-k entries are valid.
+    omitted_support_ids = [token_id for token_id in support_ids if token_id not in ids[0].tolist()]
+    sampled_id = omitted_support_ids[0] if omitted_support_ids else ids[0, 0].item()
+    flat = FlatLogprobs()
+    append_logprobs_for_next_position(
+        flat,
+        [sampled_id, *ids[0].tolist()],
+        [log_probs[0, sampled_id].item(), *head[0].tolist()],
+        [None] * (k + 1),
+        2,
+        k,
+    )
+    _, head_ids, _, complete = extract_response_topk_logprobs_with_coverage(flat, k, vocab_size=4)
+    assert complete.tolist() == [expected_complete]
+    if omitted_support_ids:
+        assert not (head_ids == sampled_id).any()

+def test_pure_top_p_overflow_scores_sample_outside_recorded_head(rule, threshold):
+    from verl.trainer.ppo.score_centering import score_centering_auto_correction, score_centering_weight_fn
+
+    # Pure top-p has no cardinality cap: this real provider keeps all four tokens,
+    # while the recording budget is two. Sample an actual nonzero-probability tail token.
+    sampler_logits = apply_top_k_top_p(torch.zeros(1, 4, device="cuda"), None, torch.tensor([0.9], device="cuda"))
+    sampler_lp = sampler_logits.log_softmax(-1)
+    assert int(sampler_lp.isfinite().sum()) == 4
+    q_head, ids = sampler_lp.topk(2, -1)
+    sampled_id = next(i for i in range(4) if i not in ids[0].tolist())
+    flat = FlatLogprobs()
+    append_logprobs_for_next_position(
+        flat,
+        [sampled_id, *ids[0].tolist()],
+        [sampler_lp[0, sampled_id].item(), *q_head[0].tolist()],
+        [None] * 3,
+        4,
+        2,
+    )
+    q_sample, _, recorded, complete = extract_response_topk_logprobs_with_coverage(flat, 2, vocab_size=4)
+    assert complete.tolist() == [False]
+    trainer = torch.tensor([[2.0, 1.0, 0.0, -1.0]], device="cuda", requires_grad=True)
+    lp = trainer.log_softmax(-1)
+    weight = score_centering_weight_fn(rule, threshold)
+    correction, shift, mass, _ = score_centering_auto_correction(
+        lp.gather(-1, ids),
+        torch.as_tensor(recorded, device="cuda"),
+        weight,
+        torch.as_tensor(complete, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    assert mass.item() == pytest.approx(0.5)
+    assert shift.item() == 0
+    sampled = lp[:, sampled_id] - shift
+    actual_q_sample = torch.as_tensor(q_sample, device="cuda")
+    sampled_weight = weight((sampled.detach() - actual_q_sample).exp())
+    loss = -(sampled_weight * sampled - correction).mean()
+    assert torch.isfinite(torch.autograd.grad(loss, trainer)[0]).all()

+"""CPU coverage for score centering's FSDP engine wiring."""
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from tensordict import TensorDict
+
+from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
+from verl.utils.dataset.dataset_utils import DatasetPadMode
+from verl.workers.engine.fsdp.transformer_impl import FSDPEngineWithLMHead

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_remove_padding", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("score_centering", [True, False])
+def test_prepare_model_outputs_keeps_logits_intact_for_score_centering(use_remove_padding, score_centering):
+    """The score centering hook saves the logits and re-reads them in its backward, so the engine
+    must not run the flash-attn cross-entropy backward that writes the gradient into the logits."""
+    seq_lengths = torch.tensor([3, 2])
+    total_nnz, vocab_size = int(seq_lengths.sum()), 8
+    cu_seqlens = torch.cat([torch.tensor([0]), seq_lengths.cumsum(0)])
+    input_ids = torch.nested.nested_tensor_from_jagged(torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (total_nnz,)), offsets=cu_seqlens)
+    output = type("Output", (), {})()
+    output_args = {"input_ids_rmpad_rolled": torch.randint(0, vocab_size, (total_nnz,))}
+    if use_remove_padding:
+        output.logits = torch.randn(1, total_nnz, vocab_size)
+        output_args.update(temperature_rmpad=torch.ones(total_nnz), pad_size=0)
+    else:
+        output.logits = torch.randn(2, 3, vocab_size)
+        output_args["temperature"] = torch.ones(2)
+
+    micro_batch = TensorDict({"input_ids": input_ids}, batch_size=[])
+    tu.assign_non_tensor(
+        micro_batch,
+        use_remove_padding=use_remove_padding,
+        pad_mode=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING,
+        score_centering=score_centering,
+    )
+    engine = object.__new__(FSDPEngineWithLMHead)
+    engine.use_ulysses_sp = False
+
+    def logits_processor(student_logits, data):
+        return {"sc_correction": torch.zeros(student_logits.shape[:2])}
+
+    with patch(
+        "verl.workers.engine.fsdp.transformer_impl.logprobs_from_logits", return_value=torch.zeros(total_nnz)
+    ) as mock_logprobs:
+        FSDPEngineWithLMHead.prepare_model_outputs(engine, output, output_args, micro_batch, logits_processor)
+
+    assert mock_logprobs.call_args.kwargs.get("inplace_backward", True) is not score_centering

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _ShardLocation:
+    """Where one rank's local shard of a DTensor sits in the full tensor.
+
+    VeOmni shards dense params on a 1-D FSDP mesh, and routed experts on a 1-D ``ep_fsdp`` mesh whose root
+    mesh also carries the ``ep`` dim: each ep rank owns a contiguous run of experts along dim 0.
+    """
+
+    shard_rank: int
+    ep_rank: int
+    ep_size: int
+    replica: bool
+
+
+def _locate_shard(tensor: DTensor) -> _ShardLocation:
+    mesh = tensor.device_mesh
+    if mesh.ndim != 1 or len(tensor.placements) != 1:
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"Only 1-D DTensor meshes are supported, got {mesh.mesh_dim_names} with {tensor.placements}"
+        )
+    root = mesh._get_root_mesh()
+    root_coordinate = dict(zip(root.mesh_dim_names, root.get_coordinate(), strict=True))
+    replica = any(coord != 0 for dim, coord in root_coordinate.items() if dim.endswith("replicate"))
+    if "ep" in root_coordinate and mesh.mesh_dim_names[0] != "ep":
+        ep_rank, ep_size = root_coordinate["ep"], root.size(root.mesh_dim_names.index("ep"))
+    else:
+        ep_rank, ep_size = 0, 1
+    return _ShardLocation(mesh.get_coordinate()[0], ep_rank, ep_size, replica)
