+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE = 32
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# MXFP4 experts
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_MXFP4_PARAMS = (
+    "w13_weight",
+    "w2_weight",
+    "w13_weight_scale",
+    "w2_weight_scale",
+    "w13_weight_bias",
+    "w2_weight_bias",
+)
+_MXFP4_DERIVED_PARAMS = ("gemm1_alpha", "gemm1_beta", "gemm1_clamp_limit")
+_NVFP4_PARAMS = ("w13_weight", "w2_weight", "w13_weight_scale", "w2_weight_scale")
+_NVFP4_DERIVED_PARAMS = (
+    "w13_weight_scale_2",
+    "w2_weight_scale_2",
+    "g1_alphas",
+    "g2_alphas",
+    "w13_input_scale_quant",
+    "w2_input_scale_quant",
+)
+
+
+def _is_mxfp4_moe(module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    qm = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+    return qm is not None and (type(qm).__name__ == "Mxfp4MoEMethod" or getattr(qm, "_verl_mxfp4_moe_method", False))
+
+
+def _mxfp4_checkpoint_layout(module: torch.nn.Module) -> dict[str, tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype]]:
+    """Canonical compressed-tensors layout consumed by ``FusedMoE.weight_loader``."""
+    qm = module.quant_method
+    experts = module.num_local_experts
+    intermediate = qm.intermediate_size_per_partition
+    hidden = qm.hidden_size
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": ((experts, 2 * intermediate, hidden // 2), torch.uint8),
+        "w2_weight": ((experts, hidden, intermediate // 2), torch.uint8),
+        "w13_weight_scale": ((experts, 2 * intermediate, hidden // MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE), torch.uint8),
+        "w2_weight_scale": ((experts, hidden, intermediate // MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE), torch.uint8),
+        "w13_weight_bias": ((experts, 2 * intermediate), torch.bfloat16),
+        "w2_weight_bias": ((experts, hidden), torch.bfloat16),
+    }
+
+
+def _mxfp4_staging_data(data: torch.Tensor, shape: tuple[int, ...], dtype: torch.dtype, *, zero: bool) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Return a checkpoint-layout view when it spans the live storage, otherwise allocate."""
+    shape = torch.Size(shape)
+    if data.dtype == dtype and data.shape == shape:
+        return data
+    if data.is_contiguous() and data.numel() * data.element_size() == shape.numel() * dtype.itemsize:
+        return data.flatten().view(dtype).reshape(shape)
+    factory = torch.zeros if zero else torch.empty
+    return factory(shape, dtype=dtype, device=data.device)
+
+
+def stage_mxfp4_moe_params(model: torch.nn.Module):
+    """Expose canonical MXFP4 expert tensors for all buckets of one refit.
+
+    The packed weights and scales generally reuse the live kernel storage by a
+    dtype view. Biases are zeroed canonical buffers because SGLang creates them
+    for the SM100 FlashInfer ABI even when the HF model has no expert biases.
+    """
+    pending = []
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_mxfp4_moe(module):
+            continue
+        qm = module.quant_method
+        supported = (
+            getattr(qm, "use_flashinfer", False) and getattr(qm, "_fi_kernel", None) == "trtllm_sm100"
+        ) or getattr(qm, "use_deep_gemm", False)
+        if not supported:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                f"{name}: SGLang MXFP4 refit supports the Blackwell flashinfer_mxfp4 and deep_gemm backends; "
+                f"got _fi_kernel={getattr(qm, '_fi_kernel', None)!r}, "
+                f"use_deep_gemm={getattr(qm, 'use_deep_gemm', False)}"
+            )
+        params = {}
+        for pname, (shape, dtype) in _mxfp4_checkpoint_layout(module).items():
+            param = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(param, torch.nn.Parameter):
+                continue
+            staging = _mxfp4_staging_data(param.data, shape, dtype, zero=pname.endswith("_bias"))
+            params[pname] = (param, param.data, staging)
+        derived = {
+            pname: getattr(module, pname)
+            for pname in _MXFP4_DERIVED_PARAMS
+            if isinstance(getattr(module, pname, None), torch.Tensor)
+        }
+        pending.append((name, module, params, derived))
+
+    # Allocate everything before rebinding anything, so OOM cannot leave a
+    # partially staged model whose state was never returned to the caller.
+    for _, module, params, _ in pending:
+        for pname, (param, _, staging) in params.items():
+            param.data = staging
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight"):
+                # compressed-tensors exports ``weight_packed``. Qwen3.5 keeps
+                # that suffix while mapping per-expert names to the fused
+                # parameter, so publish the checkpoint alias for params_dict.
+                setattr(module, f"{pname}_packed", param)
+    return pending
+
+
+def restore_mxfp4_live(staged) -> None:
+    for _, module, params, derived in staged:
+        for pname, (param, live, _) in params.items():
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight") and hasattr(module, f"{pname}_packed"):
+                delattr(module, f"{pname}_packed")
+            param.data = live
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+        for pname, live in derived.items():
+            setattr(module, pname, live)
+
+
+def reprocess_mxfp4_moe_layers(staged) -> int:
+    """Rebuild MXFP4 kernel layouts and fold them into CUDA-graph-captured storage."""
+    count = 0
+    for name, module, params, derived in staged:
+        module.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+        for pname, (param, live, _) in params.items():
+            rebuilt = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(rebuilt, torch.Tensor):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: MXFP4 post-load processing removed the expert tensor")
+            if rebuilt.shape != live.shape or rebuilt.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"{name}.{pname}: MXFP4 post-load processing produced "
+                    f"{tuple(rebuilt.shape)}/{rebuilt.dtype}, but CUDA graphs captured "
+                    f"{tuple(live.shape)}/{live.dtype}"
+                )
+            if rebuilt.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.copy_(rebuilt)
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight") and hasattr(module, f"{pname}_packed"):
+                delattr(module, f"{pname}_packed")
+            param.data = live
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+        for pname, live in derived.items():
+            rebuilt = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(rebuilt, torch.Tensor) or rebuilt.shape != live.shape or rebuilt.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: MXFP4 post-load processing changed a captured derived tensor")
+            if rebuilt.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.data.copy_(rebuilt.data)
+            setattr(module, pname, live)
+        count += 1
+    return count
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# NVFP4 experts
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _is_nvfp4_moe(module: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    scheme = getattr(module, "scheme", None)
+    return scheme is not None and (
+        type(scheme).__name__ == "CompressedTensorsW4A4Nvfp4MoE" or getattr(scheme, "_verl_nvfp4_moe_scheme", False)
+    )
+
+
+def stage_nvfp4_moe_params(model: torch.nn.Module):
+    """Expose compressed-tensors NVFP4 checkpoint tensors during one refit."""
+    pending = []
+    for name, module in model.named_modules():
+        if not _is_nvfp4_moe(module):
+            continue
+        scheme = module.scheme
+        if getattr(scheme, "use_flashinfer_trtllm", False):
+            raise NotImplementedError(f"{name}: SGLang NVFP4 refit supports only the flashinfer_cutlass backend")
+
+        params = {}
+        for pname in _NVFP4_PARAMS:
+            param = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(param, torch.nn.Parameter):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: SGLang NVFP4 expert parameter is missing")
+            weight_loader = getattr(module, "weight_loader", None)
+            if weight_loader is None:
+                weight_loader = getattr(param, "weight_loader", None)
+            if weight_loader is None:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: SGLang NVFP4 expert weight loader is missing")
+            param.weight_loader = weight_loader
+            if pname.endswith("_weight_scale"):
+                param.quant_method = "group"
+            # CUTLASS keeps weights byte-compatible and only swizzles block
+            # scales. Reusing the live allocation provides the canonical
+            # checkpoint buffer without doubling expert memory.
+            staging = _mxfp4_staging_data(param.data, tuple(param.shape), param.dtype, zero=False)
+            params[pname] = (param, param.data, staging)
+        derived = {
+            pname: getattr(module, pname)
+            for pname in _NVFP4_DERIVED_PARAMS
+            if isinstance(getattr(module, pname, None), torch.Tensor)
+        }
+        pending.append((name, module, params, derived))
+
+    for _, module, params, _ in pending:
+        for pname, (param, _, staging) in params.items():
+            param.data = staging
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight"):
+                setattr(module, f"{pname}_packed", param)
+    return pending
+
+
+def restore_nvfp4_live(staged) -> None:
+    for _, module, params, derived in staged:
+        for pname, (param, live, _) in params.items():
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight") and hasattr(module, f"{pname}_packed"):

+            param.data = live
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+        for pname, live in derived.items():
+            setattr(module, pname, live)
+
+
+def reprocess_nvfp4_moe_layers(staged) -> int:
+    """Rebuild NVFP4 CUTLASS scales inside CUDA-graph-captured storage."""
+    count = 0
+    for name, module, params, derived in staged:
+        module.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+        for pname, (param, live, _) in params.items():
+            rebuilt = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(rebuilt, torch.Tensor) or rebuilt.shape != live.shape or rebuilt.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: NVFP4 post-load processing changed a captured expert tensor")
+            if rebuilt.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.copy_(rebuilt)
+            if pname in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight") and hasattr(module, f"{pname}_packed"):
+                delattr(module, f"{pname}_packed")
+            param.data = live
+            setattr(module, pname, param)
+        for pname, live in derived.items():
+            rebuilt = getattr(module, pname, None)
+            if not isinstance(rebuilt, torch.Tensor) or rebuilt.shape != live.shape or rebuilt.dtype != live.dtype:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"{name}.{pname}: NVFP4 post-load processing changed a captured derived tensor")
+            if rebuilt.data_ptr() != live.data_ptr():
+                live.data.copy_(rebuilt.data)
+            setattr(module, pname, live)
+        count += 1
+    return count

+    (>= 0.5.18, ``quant_method.mxfp8_dense_backend``); otherwise the requested
+    ``--fp8-gemm-backend`` is returned, where ``auto`` means Triton for MXFP8.
+    """

+import os

+import torch

+from verl.utils.qat.compressed_tensors import (

+LOADER_FQN = REFIT_LOADER_FQN
+FINALIZE_MARKER = "__verl_sglang_quant_refit_finalize__"
+_SYNC_FP8_ATTR = "_verl_sglang_fp8_refit_staged"
+_SYNC_FP4_ATTR = "_verl_sglang_fp4_refit_staged"
+_SYNC_NVFP4_ATTR = "_verl_sglang_nvfp4_refit_staged"
+_SGLangRefitKind = Literal["mxfp8", "mxfp4", "nvfp4"]
+
+_REGEX_IGNORE_TO_SGLANG = {
+    r"re:.*lm_head$": "lm_head",
+    r"re:.*embed_tokens$": "embed_tokens",
+    r"re:.*visual\..*": "visual",
+    r"re:^mtp\..*": "mtp",
+    r"re:.*mlp\.gate$": "mlp.gate",
+    r"re:.*shared_expert_gate$": "shared_expert_gate",
+    r"re:.*mlp\.experts\..*": "mlp.experts",
+    # Qwen3.5 stores these separately in HF/Megatron but SGLang fuses them.
+    r"re:.*linear_attn\.in_proj_[ab]$": ("in_proj_ba", "in_proj_b", "in_proj_a"),
+}

+def resolve_sglang_quantization_config(config: Any, model_config: Any) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Return the rollout override or the model's native quantization config."""
+    quantization = getattr(config, "quantization", None)
+    if quantization is not None and quantization.enabled:
+        return quantization.build_quantization_config(model_config.local_path)
+
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    native = getattr(hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+    if native is None:
+        native = getattr(getattr(hf_config, "text_config", None), "quantization_config", None)
+    if native is None:
+        return None
+    if hasattr(native, "to_dict"):
+        native = native.to_dict()
+    if not isinstance(native, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError(f"quantization_config must be a mapping, got {type(native).__name__}")
+    return dict(native)
+
+
+def _translate_ignored_layers(ignored_layers: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
+    translated = []
+    for ignored in ignored_layers:
+        if ignored.startswith("re:"):
+            native = _REGEX_IGNORE_TO_SGLANG.get(ignored)
+            if native is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"SGLang native MXFP8 does not support regex ignored layer {ignored!r}; "
+                    "use an exact module path or add an engine-name translation"
+                )
+            native_names = native if isinstance(native, tuple) else (native,)
+        else:
+            native_names = (ignored,)
+        for native_name in native_names:
+            if native_name not in translated:
+                translated.append(native_name)
+    return translated
+
+
+def translate_mxfp8_to_sglang_fp8_config(ct_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Translate an all-MXFP8 compressed-tensors override to native SGLang."""
+    if not is_all_mxfp8_config(ct_config):
+        raise ValueError("SGLang native MXFP8 translation requires every config group to use MXFP8")
+    return {
+        "quant_method": "mxfp8",
+        "activation_scheme": "dynamic",
+        "weight_block_size": [1, 32],
+        "ignored_layers": _translate_ignored_layers(ct_config.get("ignore") or []),
+    }
+
+
+class SGLangMxfp8WeightQuantizer:
+    """Preserve CT MXFP8 numerics while emitting SGLang's native scale name."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ct_config: Mapping[str, Any]):
+        translate_mxfp8_to_sglang_fp8_config(ct_config)
+        self.compressed_tensors = CompressedTensorsWeightQuantizer(ct_config)
+
+    def refresh_input_global_scales(self, model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+        self.compressed_tensors.refresh_input_global_scales(model)
+
+    def __call__(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> Iterator[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        for name, tensor in self.compressed_tensors(weights):
+            if name.endswith(".weight_scale"):
+                name = name[: -len("weight_scale")] + "weight_scale_inv"
+            yield name, tensor
+
+
+def _sglang_refit_kind(quantization_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> _SGLangRefitKind | None:
+    """Return the format that needs SGLang's bucket-aware refit loader."""
+    if is_all_mxfp8_config(quantization_config):
+        return "mxfp8"
+    if quantization_config.get("quant_method") != "compressed-tensors":
+        return None
+
+    modes = qat_modes_for_config(quantization_config)
+    if "mxfp4_mxfp8" in modes:
+        raise ValueError("SGLang does not support MXFP8 dense linear layers with MXFP4 routed experts.")
+    if "nvfp4" in modes:
+        return "nvfp4"
+    if any("mxfp4" in mode for mode in modes):
+        return "mxfp4"
+    return None
+
+
+def uses_sglang_refit_loader(quantization_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Whether this config needs verl's bucket-aware SGLang refit loader."""
+    return _sglang_refit_kind(quantization_config) is not None
+
+
+def _is_nvfp4_quantization(quantization_config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Whether a quantization config contains the NVFP4 format."""
+    values = []
+
+    def collect(value: Any) -> None:
+        if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+            for nested in value.values():
+                collect(nested)
+        elif isinstance(value, list | tuple):
+            for nested in value:
+                collect(nested)
+        elif isinstance(value, str):
+            values.append(value.lower())
+
+    collect(quantization_config)
+    return any("nvfp4" in value for value in values)
+
+
+def set_default_sglang_quantization_backends(
+    quantization_config: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    engine_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    """Default supported FP8/MXFP8/MXFP4 backends to DeepGEMM."""
+    if quantization_config is None or _is_nvfp4_quantization(quantization_config):
+        return
+    for option in ("fp8_gemm_runner_backend", "moe_runner_backend"):
+        engine_kwargs.setdefault(option, "deep_gemm")
+
+
+def _prepare_refit_config(
+    quantization_config: Mapping[str, Any],
+    refit_kind: _SGLangRefitKind,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if refit_kind == "mxfp8":
+        native_config = translate_mxfp8_to_sglang_fp8_config(quantization_config)
+
+        # Scheduler subprocesses reconstruct ModelConfig. Mirror ignored layers
+        # through SGLang's supported environment channel so they survive.
+        existing = [item.strip() for item in os.environ.get("SGLANG_FP8_IGNORED_LAYERS", "").split(",") if item.strip()]
+        for ignored in native_config["ignored_layers"]:
+            if ignored not in existing:
+                existing.append(ignored)
+        os.environ["SGLANG_FP8_IGNORED_LAYERS"] = ",".join(existing)
+        return native_config
+
+    # Compressed-tensors raises when ordinary Linear modules match no group.
+    # MXFP4 selects FusedMoE before ignore checks; NVFP4 retains experts through
+    # its negative-lookahead pattern. Both rules keep dense layers in BF16.
+    ignored = r"re:.*" if refit_kind == "mxfp4" else r"re:^(?!.*mlp\.experts(?:\.|$)).*$"
+    native_config = deepcopy(quantization_config)
+    native_config["ignore"] = list(native_config.get("ignore") or [])
+    if ignored not in native_config["ignore"]:
+        native_config["ignore"].append(ignored)
+    return native_config
+
+
+def prepare_sglang_quantization(
+    quantization_config: dict[str, Any],
+    custom_weight_loader: list[str],
+    engine_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare one effective rollout config for SGLang launch and online refit."""
+    refit_kind = _sglang_refit_kind(quantization_config)
+    set_default_sglang_quantization_backends(quantization_config, engine_kwargs)
+
+    if refit_kind is None:
+        return quantization_config
+
+    native_config = _prepare_refit_config(quantization_config, refit_kind)
+    if REFIT_LOADER_FQN not in custom_weight_loader:
+        custom_weight_loader.append(REFIT_LOADER_FQN)
+    return native_config
+
+
+def finalize_tensors() -> list[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Return the closing payload sent after the final weight-sync bucket."""
+    return [(FINALIZE_MARKER, torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.uint8))]
+
+
+def load_and_reprocess(model: torch.nn.Module, named_tensors: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> None:
+    """Load one SGLang quantized-refit bucket and finalize kernel layouts once per sync."""
+    from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp4_utils import stage_mxfp4_moe_params, stage_nvfp4_moe_params
+    from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp8_utils import stage_mxfp8_moe_scales
+
+    named_tensors = list(named_tensors)
+    finalize = any(name == FINALIZE_MARKER for name, _ in named_tensors)
+    named_tensors = [(name, tensor) for name, tensor in named_tensors if name != FINALIZE_MARKER]
+    try:
+        if named_tensors:
+            if _SYNC_FP8_ATTR not in model.__dict__:
+                model.__dict__[_SYNC_FP8_ATTR] = stage_mxfp8_moe_scales(model)
+                model.__dict__[_SYNC_FP4_ATTR] = stage_mxfp4_moe_params(model)
+                model.__dict__[_SYNC_NVFP4_ATTR] = stage_nvfp4_moe_params(model)
+            model.load_weights(named_tensors)
+        if finalize:
+            _finish_sync(model)
+    except BaseException:
+        _abandon_sync(model)
+        raise
+
+
+def _abandon_sync(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Restore CUDA-graph-captured storage after a failed bucket or finalize request."""
+    from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp4_utils import restore_mxfp4_live, restore_nvfp4_live
+
+    for module, scale_name, live in model.__dict__.pop(_SYNC_FP8_ATTR, ()):
+        getattr(module, scale_name).data = live
+    restore_mxfp4_live(model.__dict__.pop(_SYNC_FP4_ATTR, ()))
+    restore_nvfp4_live(model.__dict__.pop(_SYNC_NVFP4_ATTR, ()))
+
+
+def _finish_sync(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Rebuild FP8/FP4 backend layouts after every bucket has been loaded."""
+    from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp4_utils import reprocess_mxfp4_moe_layers, reprocess_nvfp4_moe_layers
+    from verl.utils.sglang.sglang_fp8_utils import (
+        reprocess_mxfp8_layers,
+        reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers,
+    )
+
+    if _SYNC_FP8_ATTR not in model.__dict__:
+        return
+    fp8_staged = model.__dict__[_SYNC_FP8_ATTR]
+    fp4_staged = model.__dict__.get(_SYNC_FP4_ATTR, ())
+    nvfp4_staged = model.__dict__.get(_SYNC_NVFP4_ATTR, ())
+    reprocess_mxfp8_layers(model)
+    reprocess_mxfp8_moe_layers(model, fp8_staged)
+    reprocess_mxfp4_moe_layers(fp4_staged)
+    reprocess_nvfp4_moe_layers(nvfp4_staged)
+    del model.__dict__[_SYNC_FP8_ATTR]
+    model.__dict__.pop(_SYNC_FP4_ATTR, None)
+    model.__dict__.pop(_SYNC_NVFP4_ATTR, None)

+"""Refit support for unquantized fused-MoE layers whose kernel prep changes the weight layout.
+
+vLLM hands the unquantized expert weights to a backend-specific prep in
+``process_weights_after_loading``. FlashInfer TRT-LLM -- vLLM's default bf16
+MoE backend on SM100 -- rewrites ``w13_weight`` / ``w2_weight`` into a 4-D block
+layout (``[E, 2H/128, 2I, 64]`` for w13, where the checkpoint layout is
+``[E, 2I, H]``), so the per-expert loads of a refit no longer fit the live
+parameters (verl-project/verl#7978).
+
+The block layout keeps the byte count (or adds padding: vLLM 0.29 pads the
+intermediate dim to a multiple of 128 first), so the checkpoint layout is staged
+as a view over the live storage: the refit's loads stream straight into it, and
+nothing is buffered or copied while the buckets arrive. After the last bucket,
+vLLM's own ``process_weights_after_loading`` re-derives the kernel layout into a
+temporary, and ``replace_parameter`` -- patched for the duration of that call --
+copies it back into the live storage before the next layer is processed. The
+extra memory is one layer's temporary, and the pointers a CUDA graph captured
+stay valid. Between staging and folding the live storage holds
+checkpoint-layout bytes, so no forward pass may run in between; the refit
+already guarantees that.
+
+The checkpoint layout is read from the metadata vLLM records for every layer at
+model init for its own weight reloading, so nothing has to be patched before the
+engine starts.
+"""
+
+import logging
+import math
+import os
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from verl.utils.vllm.vllm_fp8_utils import _copy_param_subclass_attrs, _fold_into_live_param
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)
+logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "WARN"))
+
+_MOE_WEIGHT_NAMES = ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")
+# Live parameters a staged layer set aside, by name, until the fold puts them back.
+_LIVE_ATTR = "_verl_moe_live_params"
+
+
+def _checkpoint_layouts(layer, layerwise_info) -> dict[str, tuple[tuple[int, ...], torch.dtype]]:
+    """The expert weights' checkpoint (shape, dtype), as vLLM recorded them at model init."""
+    info = layerwise_info.get(layer)
+    if info is None:
+        return {}
+    params, _ = info.restore_metadata
+    return {name: (tuple(params[name].shape), params[name].dtype) for name in _MOE_WEIGHT_NAMES if name in params}
+
+
+def _staging_data(param, shape, dtype):
+    """Checkpoint-layout tensor for the refit's loads to write into.
+
+    A view over the live storage whenever that has room -- the kernel layout
+    keeps the checkpoint's bytes or pads them -- so staging allocates nothing.
+    Otherwise a fresh buffer, all-ones bytes (NaN in bf16/fp16/fp32), so a
+    weight the stream fails to write cannot pass for a real one.
+    """
+    nbytes = math.prod(shape) * dtype.itemsize
+    live = param.data
+    if live.is_contiguous() and live.nbytes >= nbytes:
+        return live.reshape(-1).view(torch.uint8)[:nbytes].view(dtype).view(shape)
+    staging = torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype, device=live.device)
+    staging.view(torch.uint8).fill_(0xFF)
+    return staging
+
+
+def stage_unquantized_moe_params(model: torch.nn.Module) -> list[torch.nn.Module]:
+    """Give ``load_weights`` checkpoint-layout expert weights where the kernel prep reshaped them.
+
+    Returns the staged layers, to be passed to ``fold_unquantized_moe_params``
+    around the post-load processing. Layers whose live weights keep the
+    checkpoint layout (Triton, FlashInfer CUTLASS's same-shape gate/up swap)
+    already load as-is and are left alone.
+    """
+    try:
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import unquantized_fused_moe_method
+        from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload.layerwise import LAYERWISE_INFO
+    except ImportError:
+        return []
+    # The fold redirects the module-level ``replace_parameter`` that ``_setup_kernel`` writes through.
+    if not hasattr(unquantized_fused_moe_method, "replace_parameter"):
+        return []
+
+    staged, fresh_bytes = [], 0
+    for _, layer in model.named_modules():
+        if not isinstance(getattr(layer, "quant_method", None), unquantized_fused_moe_method.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+            continue
+        stale = getattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR, None)
+        if stale is not None:
+            # An earlier refit failed between staging and folding: start over from the live parameters.
+            for name, param in stale.items():
+                setattr(layer, name, param)
+            delattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR)
+
+        live = {}
+        for name, (shape, dtype) in _checkpoint_layouts(layer, LAYERWISE_INFO).items():
+            param = getattr(layer, name, None)
+            if not isinstance(param, torch.nn.Parameter) or (tuple(param.shape) == shape and param.dtype == dtype):
+                continue
+            data = _staging_data(param, shape, dtype)
+            if data.data_ptr() != param.data_ptr():
+                fresh_bytes += data.nbytes
+            staged_param = torch.nn.Parameter(data, requires_grad=False)
+            _copy_param_subclass_attrs(staged_param, param)
+            # The record goes on the layer before the parameter is swapped out, so a failure part way
+            # through still leaves the next refit what it restores from.
+            setattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR, live)
+            live[name] = param
+            setattr(layer, name, staged_param)
+
+        if live:
+            staged.append(layer)
+
+    if staged:
+        logger.info("Staged %d unquantized MoE layers in checkpoint layout for the refit", len(staged))
+    if fresh_bytes:
+        logger.warning(
+            "An unquantized MoE kernel layout has no room for the checkpoint layout, so %.1f MB of "
+            "checkpoint-layout staging buffers were allocated for this refit",
+            fresh_bytes / 2**20,
+        )
+    return staged
+
+
+def _folding_replace_parameter(original):
+    def replace_parameter(layer, param_name, new_data, *args, **kwargs):
+        live = getattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR, None)
+        param = live.get(param_name) if live and new_data is not None else None
+        if param is None:
+            return original(layer, param_name, new_data, *args, **kwargs)
+        # Into the storage the CUDA graph captured, right away: the temporary is freed before the next layer.
+        _fold_into_live_param(layer, param_name, param, new_data)
+        # Dropped only once folded: a fold that raises leaves the record the next refit restores from.
+        del live[param_name]
+
+    return replace_parameter
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def fold_unquantized_moe_params(layers: list[torch.nn.Module]):
+    """Route the staged layers' re-derived weights into their live storage during post-load processing."""
+    if not layers:
+        yield
+        return
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import unquantized_fused_moe_method
+
+    folding = _folding_replace_parameter(unquantized_fused_moe_method.replace_parameter)
+    with patch.object(unquantized_fused_moe_method, "replace_parameter", folding):
+        yield
+
+    for layer in layers:
+        # Whatever the patch did not see: a backend that bypassed the module-level name still left its
+        # kernel layout on the layer, but a staged view left there means nothing re-derived the weight.
+        live = getattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR, None) or {}
+        for name, param in list(live.items()):
+            current = getattr(layer, name)
+            if tuple(current.shape) != tuple(param.shape):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"{type(layer).__name__}.{name} was not re-derived into its kernel layout after the refit: "
+                    f"the checkpoint-layout view {tuple(current.shape)} is still on the layer"
+                )
+            _fold_into_live_param(layer, name, param, current)
+            del live[name]
+        if hasattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR):
+            delattr(layer, _LIVE_ATTR)

+class ContextParallelGather(torch.autograd.Function):
+    """All-gather along dim 0 whose backward keeps only the local slice.
+
+    Every CP rank computes the same loss on the gathered tensor, so the upstream gradient is
+    identical across CP ranks and its local slice is already the full gradient of the local shard.
+    Summing it across ranks (the default all-gather backward) would scale gradients by the CP size.
+    """
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def forward(ctx, tensor: torch.Tensor, group: torch.distributed.ProcessGroup) -> torch.Tensor:
+        ctx.rank = torch.distributed.get_rank(group)
+        ctx.world_size = torch.distributed.get_world_size(group)
+        tensor = tensor.contiguous()
+        gathered = tensor.new_empty((tensor.size(0) * ctx.world_size, *tensor.shape[1:]))
+        torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(gathered, tensor, group=group)
+        return gathered
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def backward(ctx, grad_output: torch.Tensor):
+        return grad_output.chunk(ctx.world_size, dim=0)[ctx.rank], None

+    rollout or checkpoint uses SGLang's quantized MoE methods instead and is left alone.

+def extract_response_topk_logprobs(logprobs, k: int) -> tuple[list[float], np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Sampled-token log-probs and the sampler top-k head per generated token.
+
+    ``logprobs`` is a vLLM ``FlatLogprobs`` (``SamplingParams(flat_logprobs=True)``), which stores
+    ``[sampled, top-1, ..., top-k]`` for every position in flat lists. Reshaping them avoids
+    rebuilding one Logprob dict per position on the server event loop, and numpy arrays avoid
+    shipping millions of Python scalars through Ray.
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple containing:
+            sampled_log_probs: Sampled-token log-probs, length T.
+            ids: Top-k token ids ordered by rank, shape (T, k), dtype int32.
+            log_probs: Top-k log-probs matching ``ids``, shape (T, k), dtype float32.
+    """
+    if k <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("the sampler head size must be positive")
+    num_tokens, width = len(logprobs), k + 1
+    if len(logprobs.token_ids) != num_tokens * width or len(logprobs.logprobs) != num_tokens * width:
+        raise ValueError(f"expected {width} logprob entries per generated token, got {len(logprobs.token_ids)} total")
+    # Checking only the total permits a short row and a long row to cancel out. Never invent
+    # missing slots: an -inf slot proves a zero probability only when the provider returned it.
+    if hasattr(logprobs, "start_indices") and hasattr(logprobs, "end_indices"):
+        if logprobs.start_indices != list(range(0, num_tokens * width, width)) or logprobs.end_indices != list(
+            range(width, (num_tokens + 1) * width, width)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"expected {width} logprob entries per generated token with contiguous flat rows")
+    ids = np.asarray(logprobs.token_ids, dtype=np.int32).reshape(num_tokens, width)
+    log_probs = np.asarray(logprobs.logprobs, dtype=np.float32).reshape(num_tokens, width)
+    head_ids, head_log_probs = ids[:, 1:], log_probs[:, 1:]
+    if np.any(ids < 0) or np.any(np.isnan(log_probs)) or np.any(np.isposinf(log_probs)) or np.any(log_probs > 1e-6):
+        raise ValueError("sampler top-k ids must be nonnegative and log-probs must be finite or -inf")
+    if not np.all(np.isfinite(log_probs[:, 0])) or np.any(~np.isfinite(head_log_probs).any(-1)):
+        raise ValueError("the sampled token and at least one head token must have finite log-probs")
+    if np.any(head_log_probs[:, :-1] < head_log_probs[:, 1:]):
+        raise ValueError("sampler top-k log-probs must be ordered by rank")
+    sorted_ids = np.sort(head_ids, axis=-1)
+    if np.any(sorted_ids[:, :-1] == sorted_ids[:, 1:]):
+        raise ValueError("sampler top-k ids must be unique within each head")
+    if np.any(np.exp(head_log_probs).sum(-1) > 1.0 + 1e-5):
+        raise ValueError("sampler top-k head probability mass must not exceed one")

+def extract_response_topk_logprobs_with_coverage(
+    logprobs, k: int, vocab_size: int | None = None
+) -> tuple[list[float], np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Extract a global ranked top-k head and evidence that its support is complete.
+
+    Call only for the provider's global top-k, never custom ``logprob_token_ids``: that path
+    can use -inf for missing-record padding. Real vLLM FlatLogprobs offsets and ranks are
+    checked, so a short record cannot be mistaken for zero-probability slots. Without this
+    provider layout the evidence is unknown (False), including legacy records.
+
+    A returned -inf in a global top-k proves that every omitted token also has probability
+    zero. Recording the entire model vocabulary also proves completeness. An all-finite
+    partial head remains unknown even if its probability mass rounds to one. Returns the
+    usual sampled log-probs, ids and head log-probs, plus a bool array of shape (T,).
+    """
+    sampled, ids, head_log_probs = extract_response_topk_logprobs(logprobs, k)
+    complete = np.zeros(len(sampled), dtype=np.bool_)
+    sampled_ids = np.asarray(logprobs.token_ids[:: k + 1], dtype=np.int32)
+    if vocab_size is not None:

+            raise ValueError("sampler top-k ids and sampled ids must lie within the model vocabulary")
+    if not all(hasattr(logprobs, key) for key in ("start_indices", "end_indices", "ranks")):

+    if k == vocab_size:

+    sampled_in_head = ((ids == sampled_ids[:, None]) & np.isfinite(head_log_probs)).any(-1)
+    if np.any(complete & ~sampled_in_head):

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import VocabParallelEmbedding
 
 WeightUpdate = tuple[str, torch.Tensor]
 
 
+def tied_embedding_aliases(model: torch.nn.Module) -> set[str]:
+    """Names of tied word-embedding parameters vLLM skips when loading.
+
+    Mirrors vLLM's own alias detection (``_get_tied_embedding_params``): only
+    ``VocabParallelEmbedding`` parameters count, and the first qualname reached
+    by traversal is the canonical one every alias defers to.
+    """
+    canonical: dict[int, str] = {}
+    aliases: set[str] = set()
+    for prefix, submodule in model.named_modules(remove_duplicate=False):
+        if not isinstance(submodule, VocabParallelEmbedding):
+            continue
+        for name, param in submodule.named_parameters(remove_duplicate=False):
+            qualname = f"{prefix}.{name}" if prefix else name
+            if canonical.setdefault(id(param), qualname) != qualname:
+                aliases.add(qualname)
+    return aliases
+
+
+def drop_tied_alias_updates(model: torch.nn.Module, weights: list[WeightUpdate]) -> list[WeightUpdate]:
+    """Drop tied-embedding aliases (e.g. ``lm_head.weight``) from ``weights``.
+
+    ``state_dict()`` on the trainer side lists every qualname of a tied
+    parameter, so a refit bucket can carry ``lm_head.weight`` without the
+    ``model.embed_tokens.weight`` it aliases. vLLM skips the alias and then
+    rejects the bucket because the canonical name never loaded in it. The alias
+    is the same storage, so dropping it loses nothing.
+
+    ``aliases`` holds vLLM qualnames, while ``weights`` arrives in checkpoint
+    naming, so names go through the model's ``hf_to_vllm_mapper`` first — the
+    same order ``AutoWeightsLoader.load_weights`` uses. Without it a wrapped
+    model never matches: Qwen3.5-VL sends ``lm_head.weight`` for what vLLM calls
+    ``language_model.lm_head.weight``.
+    """
+    aliases = tied_embedding_aliases(model)
+    if not aliases:
+        return weights
+
+    mapper = getattr(model, "hf_to_vllm_mapper", None)
+
+    def is_alias(name: str) -> bool:
+        if mapper is not None:
+            # An empty result means the mapper drops the weight outright; leave
+            # that to vLLM rather than treating it as an alias.
+            mapped = mapper.apply_list([name])
+            name = mapped[0] if mapped else name
+        return name in aliases
+
+    return [(name, tensor) for name, tensor in weights if not is_alias(name)]
